title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer
description:
Please apply on the link below:







What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

- Direct working relationship with the COO of a fast-scaling creator agency; you'll see how senior decisions actually get made

- A role where you're trusted, not micromanaged, trained early, then given your lane to run

- Daily exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) used at a professional level

- 100% remote, Philippines-based, full-time (8 hrs/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours

- A genuine career-defining seat for an experienced EA, close to the executive table, broad exposure across the business



The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines.



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)

- Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable

- Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice

- Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits

- ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief

- Calendar management across multiple people's schedules

- Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- Native English



Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable)

- Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs.

- A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task

- Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions

- Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done





Location & Hours

100% remote, based in the Philippines.

Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours.



How You'll Be Measured

- This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are:

- Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off

- Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth

- Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early

- COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Production & Supplier Sourcing Coordinator
description:
Hello! We're Earth Moon Magick, a premium spiritual brand creating oracle and tarot decks, ritual tools, and ceremonial goods used by people all over the world. Our products are thoughtful, beautiful, and rooted in meaning, and we're growing fast — we now have the capacity to invest more heavily in new products, which means more suppliers, more packaging runs, and more production to manage.

~What You'll Be Doing~



Supplier Sourcing & Communication

- Share regular, easy-to-follow status updates with leadership and teammates

- Support teammates covering related tasks during the transition period, and help bring new suppliers fully up to speed

- Experience sourcing or managing suppliers for physical products — packaging, specialty goods, or CPG production experience is a strong plus

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to track multiple suppliers and production runs at once without "dropping the ball"

We care about skill, and about mindset and value alignment. We're looking for someone who:

- Has a growth mindset

- Takes ownership of their work

- Is highly organized with a strong eye for detail

- Enjoys learning and improving

- Communicates clearly and reliably

- Interest in spirituality, tarot, or conscious brands / way of life is a plus, but not required

Growth

Direct input into production standards at an expanding agency





THE ROLE

We are a fast-growing creator management and digital media agency producing high-volume short-form video content. We are hiring a Short-Form Video Quality & Compliance Manager to own the final approval layer between our editing team and everything that goes live.



This is not a creative or editing role. You are the gatekeeper. Every piece of short-form video output passes through you before it is published. You approve it or you send it back — and you make sure the same mistake does not happen twice.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Approve or reject every post before it goes live, checking each edit against our quality standards and the rules of every platform it is posted to.

• Keep platform compliance current — track policy changes across all major social platforms and update internal frameworks so the team always works to live rules.

• Hold the quality bar consistently across all editors so output does not drift person to person.

• Coach editors through clear, direct written feedback on rejected work so the same issues stop recurring.

• Own creator feedback — triage incoming feedback on edits and convert it into tangible quality improvements.

• Build the review infrastructure — design and maintain the checklists and quality logic that sit underneath the production process.



WHAT THIS REQUIRES



Experience (non-negotiable)

• 3+ years in a quality assurance, compliance, or video editing role.

• A proven track record of holding a consistent quality bar on short-form video output.

• Working knowledge of social media platform policies and how content gets restricted or removed.



Skills (must-have)

• Sharp eye for short-form video quality — able to spot what is below the bar instantly and articulate why.

• Strong grasp of platform terms of service, with the discipline to keep that knowledge current.

• Process and checklist design — able to turn a standard into a repeatable, scalable review system.

• Clear, direct feedback writing that improves work without damaging the editor relationship.

• Proficient in Airtable



Personality (non-negotiable)

• Self-starter who runs their lane without needing to be chased.

• Detail obsessive — the small miss is the one that gets an account flagged.

• Comfortable being the person who says no and holds the line.

• Consistent under volume — the same standard on reel one and reel one hundred.

• Ownership-minded — a wrong post or an open complaint is yours to close, not to pass on.

title: Joinery Drafter (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
About Us

The Sourcing Co. is a Singapore-headquartered sourcing and supply company with offices across Singapore, China, PNG, and Australia. We work across three verticals: apparel manufacturing, branded merchandise, and industrial/commercial supply. Joinery is a significant and growing product line for us - we source and supply custom joinery products to our clients, manufacturing through our supplier network in China.



The Role

We need a skilled Joinery Drafter who can take Australian architectural and interior design drawings and convert them into precise, fabrication-ready shop drawings that our Chinese manufacturing suppliers can build from without ambiguity.

This is a specialist, high-impact role. You sit at the critical translation point between what our Australian clients want and what our Chinese factory produces. If that handoff is wrong, the product is wrong. We need someone who understands both the Australian joinery industry standard and what a Chinese fabricator needs to see on a drawing to execute correctly.



What You'll Be Doing

1. Receiving architectural and interior design drawings (plans, elevations, sections) from Australian clients and our sales team

2. Translating these into detailed joinery shop drawings / workshop drawings ready for fabrication

3. Producing drawings that include: elevations, sections, joinery details, material callouts, hardware schedules, finish specifications, and fixing/installation notes

4. Coordinating with our internal team and China-side suppliers to resolve any drawing queries or clarifications

5. Managing multiple jobs in parallel, meeting turnaround targets

6. Maintaining a clean, organised drawing register and version control system

7. Flagging scope gaps, missing information, or specification conflicts before they reach the factory floor



What We're Looking For

1. Proven experience producing joinery shop drawings, specifically for the Australian market

2. Solid knowledge of Australian joinery standards, construction methods, cabinet construction, and hardware (hinges, runners, handles, locks)

3. Strong working knowledge of common joinery materials: MDF, plywood, solid timber, veneers, laminates, stone tops, glass

4. Proficient in AutoCAD (required) -- SketchUp, Polyboard, or Cabinet Vision is a plus

5. Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, interior design documentation, and specifications

6. Strong attention to detail and understanding that drawings go direct to a factory -- errors cost real money

7. Comfortable working remotely, managing your own time, and communicating via WhatsApp and

8. Experience working with or for manufacturers (China experience is a bonus, not required)



Nice to Have

1. Previous experience drafting for Chinese manufacturing suppliers

2. Familiarity with metric-to-metric translation and how Chinese factories interpret Western specifications

3. Basic understanding of manufacturing tolerances and flat-pack vs assembled joinery



What to Expect

1. Full-time, remote role based in the Philippines

2. Direct reporting line to our Group GM in Singapore

3. Fast-paced, project-driven environment -- we move quickly and expect the same

4. Opportunity to grow with a business that is scaling its joinery supply line aggressively into Australia

5. Competitive salary based on experience and proven output quality



How to Apply

1. Send your application with the following:

a) Your CV

b) A portfolio of joinery shop drawings you have personally produced (minimum 3 examples -- annotated drawings, not renders)

c) A short note (5 to 10 sentences) explaining your experience with Australian joinery projects specifically



Applications without a drawing portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Senior B2B Growth Marketing Manager | LinkedIn Ads | Google Ads | Demand Generation
description:
About the Role





This is a senior, strategy-led growth role. You own the paid acquisition and lead-gen roadmap end to end, set the numeric targets, and are measured on qualified pipeline delivered, not activity completed. You are not personally building every campaign. Execution (ad-building, copywriting, landing pages) is delegated to freelancers or agency partners that you brief, manage, and hold accountable.



The role sits across a multi-brand B2B portfolio, so a big part of the job is prioritisation: d
 where spend and attention go each quarter and being disciplined enough to pull resources from what isn't working. If you've only run one brand's ad account before, this will feel different; if you've worked agency-side or across a multi-brand group, this is likely familiar territory.



The portfolio spans creative/digital agency services, corporate travel management, staffing and recruitment, specialist tech recruitment, and security/compliance technology. Each business has a different buyer (procurement, HR, security/compliance leads, corporate travel managers), but all share a B2B sales motion: longer cycles, account-based targeting, lead quality over volume. This is a remote role and requires strong async communication given the time difference with the Australian leadership team.









Key Responsibilities



Strategy and Prioritisation



Own the B2B paid acquisition roadmap across the portfolio, prioritising spend by commercial stage and opportunity

Group companies into channel clusters by buyer and sales motion, defining platform and funnel per cluster

Set and own quarterly numeric targets per cluster with each business lead

Execution Oversight



Brief and manage freelancers or agencies per cluster; audit and correct their work

Oversee LinkedIn Ads as the primary channel, supplemented by Google Ads for intent capture

Own CRM/pipeline data hygiene; reporting is only as good as the data feeding it

Coordinate with existing SEO/organic workstreams

Reporting and Accountability



Deliver one consolidated pipeline/spend report weekly, plus a monthly per-cluster deep dive, in a fixed dashboard format, written clearly enough to be read asynchronously without a live call

Report against agreed numeric targets, not vanity metrics

Flag underperforming clusters within two weeks of a target miss and propose reallocation; do not wait to be asked

Quarterly review against targets; two consecutive missed quarters on a cluster triggers a strategy reset for that cluster, not just continued spend





Requirements



5+ years running B2B paid acquisition, ideally multi-brand, agency-side, or in a portfolio/holding company

Strong LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads experience for B2B lead gen; ABM experience a plus

Comfortable across different B2B motions (channel-led compliance sales, staffing, agency services, corporate accounts)

Track record of being measured against, and hitting, numeric pipeline targets, not just running campaigns

Fluent written and spoken English; comfortable working with Australian stakeholders and communication norms

Reliable internet connection and a dedicated home office setup suitable for client-facing calls

Self-directed; comfortable managing freelancers/agencies rather than a large in-house team





Nice to Have



Prior experience working directly with an Australian or other Western client/employer

Experience in recruitment/staffing, security/compliance tech, corporate travel, or creative agency sectors

Experience supporting a multi-business operator who needs concise, prioritised communication

Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, or similar CRM/pipeline tools

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo
/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end
 & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted
 & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for
 & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

You're the hub connecting the CEO to everyone else: the on-ground Operations Manager, Head of Marketing, Head of Brand & Growth, the finance team, plus external partners — suppliers, leasing agents, landlords, contractors and other stakeholders. 

Your job is to keep information, decisions and follow-ups flowing cleanly across all of them.



Your accountabilities::

1. Executive support & CEO leverage: Own the CEO's calendar, inbox and priorities. Protect his time, gatekeep, prep him for every meeting, handle travel and logistics, and make sure the things that grow the business get his attention.

2. Communications & stakeholder coordination: Triage the inbox daily and draft replies in the CEO's voice for approval. Be the reliable point of contact between the CEO and the Operations Manager, function heads, suppliers, leasing agents and external stakeholders, chasing, confirming and closing loops.

3. Meetings & follow-through: Turn every leadership, manager and supplier meeting into minutes and action items automatically, assign owners across the team, and chase them to completion.

4. Operating system & reporting: Maintain our Notion OS as the single source of truth.

5. Operations (with the Operations Manager): Support the on-ground Operations Manager: ensure daily store checklists are completed and audited, reconcile supplier orders against deliveries, track maintenance to closure, and surface exceptions early. Ensure weekly and monthly audits, meetings, and cadences are completed.

6. Finance (with the finance team): Coordinate with finance, chase invoice capture and daily takings reconciliation, collect company data for processing into reports and dashboards.

7. People & HR / recruitment: Provide all back-end support for the hiring pipeline end to end (screen, shortlist, schedule, onboard); prepare onboarding packs and keep compliance current (contracts, right-to-work, food-safety certs); track wage % to sales and turnover by store; keep training records up to date.

8. Marketing (with the Head of Marketing): Keep the promo calendar running; ensure marketing draft social posts and review responses for approval; monitor reviews across all stores; support local marketing ahead of new-store openings; measure every campaign's effect on sales.

9. Growth & new-store openings (with the Head of Brand & Growth and leasing agents): Drive the opening checklist for stores 4 and 5: liaise with leasing agents and landlords on sites and leases, coordinate permits, fit-out timelines, POS/supplier setup, hiring/training pipelines and launch marketing, so each store opens on time and on-plan.

10. Systems, SOPs & continuous improvement: Document how we do things, build and refine SOPs and playbooks, and constantly find ways to use tools such as AI to remove manual work.



What good looks like:

Within 30 days: the CEO spends most of his week on growth, not admin; every store's numbers are visible each Monday; the leadership team is aligned and following through; and the business strengthens its systems and processes



You're right for this if you:

Have 3+ years as a senior EA, Chief of Staff, or operations right-hand; are fluent with AI tools and use them daily; are ruthlessly organised; write clear, warm, professional English; are numbers-confident; work well across teams and external partners; and take full ownership. Experience with Notion, Microsoft 365/Outlook, and multi-location hospitality/retail is a strong plus.



To apply:

Start your message with the word "BURGER" so I know you read this. Tell me about one time you used an AI tool to save serious time, multiply force, and briefly why you'd thrive coordinating this much across a team.

description:
We are a growing HVAC company based in the United States looking for a confident, friendly, and well-spoken Remote Sales Caller / Appointment Setter to join our team.



Your main role will be calling property managers, general contractors, and home builders to introduce our HVAC company and ask if they are looking for a reliable HVAC partner for service, installs, repairs, or ongoing projects.



This is not a pushy corporate sales role. We are looking for someone who can sound natural, human, and conversational on the phone. You should be able to build rapport, ask good questions, listen carefully, and carry a real conversation with U.S.-based business owners and managers.



You will be taught the scripts, call flow, conversations, and basic HVAC information. However, you must be comfortable speaking English, understanding U.S. customers, and responding naturally when the conversation does not go exactly according to the script.



Responsibilities:



Call property managers, general contractors, builders, and other potential business clients

Introduce our HVAC company in a friendly and professional way

Ask if they currently need a new HVAC company or backup HVAC partner

Follow a script while still sounding natural and conversational

Handle basic questions and objections with confidence

Schedule appointments or follow-up calls for the company owners/team

Update leads, notes, and follow-ups inside our CRM

Help build long-term relationships with potential business clients



Requirements:



Strong spoken English and good listening skills

Comfortable making outbound cold calls

Able to understand conversational U.S. English, including different accents, phrases, and casual business conversation

Friendly, confident, and not robotic on the phone

Able to banter back and forth naturally with U.S. clients

Willing to follow scripts, learn our process, and improve over time

Organized and able to track leads and follow-ups properly

Reliable internet connection, working computer/laptop, and quiet work environment

Previous cold calling, appointment setting, sales, or VA experience is preferred

Experience with HVAC, construction, property management, or contractors is a plus, but not required



Who We Are Looking For:



We are looking for someone who is personable, coachable, and confident on the phone. The right person should be able to sound like a real human, not someone just reading from a script. You do not need to know HVAC already — we can teach that. But you do need to have strong communication skills, a good attitude, and the ability to connect with people.



This is a long-term opportunity with room to grow as the company grows. The right person will have the chance to work directly with the owners and become an important part of our sales and customer support team.

title: AI Video Editor for E-Commerce Supplement Brand
description:
We are hiring a highly skilled AI-focused video editor for a growing direct-response e-commerce supplement brand.



This is not a basic editing job. We need someone who understands how to create ads that hold attention, build curiosity, and get people to take action.



You should understand direct-response marketing, customer psychology, pacing, hooks, visual storytelling, and how to use AI to make high-converting ad creatives.



What You Will Be Doing



You will be creating short-form video ads for Meta placements using a mix of real footage, stock footage, images, AI-generated visuals, AI avatars, AI voiceovers, UGC-style content, product visuals, testimonials, and motion graphics.



Your main goal is to turn concepts, scripts, and research into ads that look native to the platform and keep viewers watching.



You will be responsible for:



* Editing direct-response video ads for our supplement brand

* Creating multiple variations of ads from the same concept

* Using AI tools to create realistic AI spokespersons, UGC-style characters, scenes, product visuals, image assets, and supporting footage

* Understanding how to make videos feel believable, natural, emotional, and engaging

* Choosing the right images, clips, b-roll, text, transitions, and visuals for the target audience

* Knowing when to use pauses, silence, quick cuts, zooms, captions, pattern interrupts, and emotional 
nts

* Matching visuals to the script instead of using random footage

* Creating strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

* Making ads that do not feel overly polished, corporate, or like obvious advertisements

* Reviewing competitor ads and understanding why certain creatives perform

* Taking feedback well and improving quickly



 What We Are Looking For



You must have a real understanding of **direct-response e-commerce advertising**.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to make aesthetic edits. We need someone who understands that every second of an ad matters.



You should understand:



* Hook, problem, agitation, solution, proof, offer, and call to action

* How to make an ad feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

* How pacing affects watch time and conversions

* When to slow down, pause, zoom in, cut faster, or let a 
nt breathe

* How to make subtitles easy to read and attention-grabbing

* How to use visuals to create curiosity and reinforce the message

* How to speak to older audiences and health-conscious customers without making the creative feel boring

* How to create believable UGC-style ads, talking-head ads, testimonial-style ads, review ads, and educational ads

* How to make AI-generated characters and creators look realistic and natural



### AI Skills Required



You must be very comfortable using AI tools.



This includes being able to create:



* Realistic AI people / spokesperson-style characters

* AI UGC-style creators

* AI-generated product scenes and lifestyle images

* AI voiceovers

* Lip-synced talking-head videos

* AI b-roll and visual support footage

* Different character variations for testing

* Different hooks, scripts, visuals, and concepts quickly



Experience with tools such as HeyGen, Arcads, Creatify, Veed, CapCut, Runway, Kling, Sora, Midjourney, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, or similar tools is a major plus. You do not need every tool, but you need to know how to get high-quality results fast.



### Important



Because we are in the supplement space, you must be able to follow scripts and feedback carefully. You should understand the difference between making an ad engaging and making claims that could get ads rejected.



We want creatives that are emotional, persuasive, and high-converting while still looking natural and platform-friendly.



### Requirements



* Strong English comprehension and communication

* Proven experience editing e-commerce direct-response ads

* Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok ad creatives

* Comfortable creating AI-generated people, voices, visuals, and scenes

* Strong eye for pacing, emotional storytelling, and audience psychology

* Able to take a script and make smart creative decisions independently

* Able to make multiple variations quickly

* Organized, reliable, and responsive

* Must be willing to do a paid test project before starting long-term



### To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or examples of direct-response e-commerce ads you have made

2. Examples of AI-generated talking-head, UGC-style, or avatar content you have created

3. The AI tools you are currently best at using

4. Your hourly rate or monthly rate

5. A short explanation of what makes a supplement ad convert better than a normal product ad

6. Your favorite direct-response ad you have made and why you think it worked



Please do not apply if you only do basic video editing. We are looking for someone who understands performance creative, direct response, AI content creation, and how to make ads that actually sell.

title: AI Creative Specialist — Direct Response Ads | Full-Time, Long-Term, Real Growth
description:
Read every word. The application steps at the bottom eliminate 95% of applicants. Miss them and you are auto-rejected. Attention to detail IS the job — this is the first test.

We are a US marketing company doing $137,000/month, running
 and Instagram ads that acquire patients for medical clinics across America. We are hiring one AI Creative Specialist to be our creative production engine: the person who studies our winning ads and pumps out more winners every week using AI tools plus sharp editing.

This is a make-it-convert role, not a make-it-pretty role. You are judged on one thing — do the ads you produce perform.

Why this beats every other creative job on this platform

Most creative jobs here make you a blind button-pusher. You get a task, you deliver, you never learn if it worked, you never improve.

Here you see the scoreboard. Real performance data on every ad — which won, which lost, and why. You get sharper every single week because you can see what's working on live accounts spending real money. Almost no employer gives creative people this feedback loop. We do. It's why our best people stay for years and grow with us.

And you won't be guessing what to make. We hand you a system. Every week we identify our winning ads, break down exactly why they work, turn each into a named, repeatable template, and hand it to you to execute at volume. You are not inventing in the dark — you are running a proven machine and scaling it. That's how you produce winners consistently instead of hoping.

What you produce every week



Study our current winning ads (static + video) and write a short breakdown of WHY each works — hook, first 3 seconds, angle, offer

Produce 20-40 new creatives per week — AI-generated statics, AI avatar/video variants, and B-roll + text + voiceover slideshow ads

Run our named winning templates at volume and spin fresh variations off them

Track what wins, feed it into next week's batch, compound the results

Work directly with our media buyer and founder on what to test next



Tools you must already know (rate your fluency 1-10 for each in your application)



Arcads (AI UGC ad generation) or equivalent

Higgsfield (AI image-to-video) or equivalent

CapCut / Premiere or equivalent for B-roll, text overlays, slideshow variants, voiceover

Meta Ads Library for researching and reverse-engineering winning ads

AI image tools (Midjourney or similar) for statics

Bonus: health, wellness, medical, or high-ticket direct-response experience



Who you are



You've made direct-response ads before and can prove they performed (screenshots, metrics, examples)

You know that in DR, ugly-that-converts beats beautiful-that-doesn't, every time

You think in volume — you know we test 30 to find 3 winners, and that excites you

You're fast, reliable, obsessed with hooks and pattern interrupts

You learn AI tools quickly and love pushing what they can do



The offer (read carefully — this is not a normal listing)

Salary: $1,000-$2,000 USD/month, based on proven skill. The top of that range is real and reserved for people who can show they've made ads that won. This is above market for a creative seat here because we expect A-player output and intend to keep you for years.

What money can't easily buy, that you also get:



The scoreboard — closed-loop feedback on every ad, so you become genuinely elite at DR creative, a skill that pays you for life

A system, not a guessing game — you run proven, named templates instead of inventing blind

Direct access to the founder and media team — your work ships in days, not months

Growth path — as we scale toward $1M/month, the person who owns creative production grows in pay, scope, and title

Real tools, paid for — Arcads, Higgsfield, the full stack, already funded

Stability — long-term, full-time, with a company growing fast and profitably



Our commitment to you (risk reversal both ways)

We start with a paid test project — never free work. Do it well and you're hired into a paid 2-week onboarding where we teach you our exact winning formats. You will never be left wondering if you're doing it right; we give feedback constantly.

HOW TO APPLY — follow exactly



Start your application with the exact phrase: "I read the scoreboard." Anything without this at the top is deleted unread.

In 3-4 sentences: describe one ad you made that performed, why it worked, and any metric you have.

Attach 2-3 examples of DR creatives you've made (statics or video).

List the AI creative tools you've used and rate each 1-10.

One paragraph: we'll send you one of our current winning ads — tell us why it works and 3 new variations you'd make from it. Strongest answers here get the paid test and interview.



We read every application that follows these steps. We hire on output, not resumes. Show us you can think and produce, and the seat — plus the growth behind it — is yours.

title: Full-Time Etsy Listing Guru SEO Vela Canva Infographic Specialist
description:
# Full-Time Etsy Listing Guru SEO Vela Canva Infographic Specialist



Maria Gossard Designs is looking for a highly experienced **Etsy Listing Guru** to help create winning Etsy listings for our luxury stationery, wedding invitation, holiday, gifting, and custom branding products.



This is **not a product design position**.



We are not looking for someone to design products, create artwork, or act as a general graphic designer. The products are already designed and developed by Maria Gossard Designs.



We are looking for someone who knows how to take a finished product and turn it into a polished, searchable, compelling Etsy listing that can sell.



This role requires strong Etsy listing experience, Etsy SEO, keyword research, Vela experience, product descriptions, Canva/Adobe infographic skills, Pinterest support, excellent English, and the ability to follow instructions carefully.



## About Maria Gossard Designs



Maria Gossard Designs is a high-end design and print studio specializing in luxury wedding invitations, letterpress printing, foil stamping, thermography, custom monograms, watercolor artwork, fine stationery, holiday collections, elevated gifts, and custom branding projects.



Our products are refined, romantic, heirloom-quality, and detail-driven. This is not a generic Etsy shop selling t-shirts, mugs, blankets, dish towels, or mass-market products. We create elevated paper goods, luxury wedding stationery, custom artwork, premium gifting products, and meaningful pieces for clients who care about beauty, quality, and detail.



We are looking for someone who understands that a winning Etsy listing requires more than a pretty photo. It requires strong keywords, clear product positioning, accurate details, buyer-focused descriptions, complete attributes, helpful infographics, and a structure that makes the customer feel confident purchasing.



## The Role



Your job is to take products we design and develop and help create strong Etsy listings from start to finish.



This includes keyword research, SEO strategy, listing titles, tags, product descriptions, categories, attributes, pricing structure, variations, personalization fields, customer clarity, Canva/Adobe listing infographics, Pinterest support, and identifying what listing images or product education graphics are needed.



We need someone who understands how Etsy shoppers search, how listings rank, and how to structure a listing so the product is easy to understand and compelling to purchase.



## Position Details



This position is full time: **40 hours per week**

Starting pay: **$200 per week**

Schedule during onboarding: **Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time**

Work location: **Fully remote**



The starting compensation includes the opportunity for **performance-based bonuses, professional growth, and possible compensation increases** as the role develops and results are demonstrated.



During the initial onboarding period, you must be available during Eastern Time business hours so we can establish workflow, communication, brand standards, and accuracy. Once trust, consistency, and independent execution are established, there may be an opportunity to shift some working hours to daytime hours in the Philippines.



## Required Etsy & Vela Experience



Please apply only if you have **at least 3 years of hands-on experience working on the Etsy platform**.



This must include direct experience creating, editing, optimizing, and improving Etsy listings. We are not looking for someone who has only worked on Shopify, Amazon, eBay, WooCommerce, or general e-commerce. Those platforms are helpful, but this role requires specific Etsy experience.



Experience with **Vela is required** for this position.



For security and operational reasons, we do not provide direct VA access to our Etsy shop. Our coaches have advised us not to give virtual assistants direct access to our Etsy store, so this role requires someone who already understands how to work through Vela for Etsy listing creation, editing, organization, and optimization.



You must be comfortable using Vela to help create, edit, update, duplicate, and manage Etsy listings, including titles, tags, descriptions, photos, categories, attributes, variations, personalization fields, and product details.



Please do not apply if you have never used Vela or if you do not have at least 3 years of Etsy platform experience.



## Required Experience



Please apply only if you have direct experience with most or all of the following:



* At least **3 years of hands-on Etsy platform experience**

* Direct experience creating, editing, optimizing, and improving Etsy listings

* **Vela experience required**

* Etsy SEO

* Etsy keyword research

* Etsy titles, tags, descriptions, categories, attributes, variations, and personalization sections

* Creating listings that are structured to convert

* Understanding Etsy search behavior and buyer intent

* Competitor and keyword research

* Writing clear, polished product descriptions

* Canva for Etsy listing images, infographics, Pinterest pins, and social media graphics

* Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop for preparing listing support graphics

* Creating listing infographics and customer education graphics

* Pinterest as a traffic driver for Etsy products

* Pinterest titles, descriptions, keywords, and pin strategy

* Using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity to improve research, listing copy, and workflow

* Excellent written English

* Strong communication skills

* Careful attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions exactly



Experience with luxury products, stationery, wedding invitations, gifts, handmade products, or premium e-commerce is a major advantage.



## Design & Infographic Skills Required



This is not a product design role. The products, artwork, and creative direction are developed by Maria Gossard Designs.



However, this role does require the ability to create the supporting graphics needed for strong Etsy listings and product launches.



You must be comfortable using **Canva** and preferably **Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop** to create polished, clear, and brand-appropriate listing graphics.



You should be able to create:



* Etsy listing infographics

* “What’s Included” graphics

* Size and dimension guides

* Product feature callouts

* Personalization instruction graphics

* Ordering process graphics

* Printing method explanation graphics

* Paper, envelope, ribbon, wax seal, or material information graphics

* Pinterest pins

* Social media graphics for product launches

* Simple product comparison graphics

* FAQ or “How To Order” listing slides



The goal is not to redesign the product. The goal is to help the customer clearly understand the product, feel confident purchasing, and see the value of a luxury, custom, or handmade item.



All graphics must feel elevated, clean, polished, and consistent with a luxury stationery, wedding invitation, holiday, gifting, and custom branding brand.



## Main Responsibilities



Daily responsibilities may include:



1. Creating new Etsy listings for products we design and develop.



2. Performing deep keyword research before each listing is created.



3. Writing SEO-friendly Etsy titles that balance search visibility and buyer appeal.



4. Creating strong Etsy tags based on keyword research and customer search behavior.



5. Writing clear, polished, persuasive product descriptions in a refined luxury brand tone.



6. Completing Etsy categories, attributes, variations, personalization fields, materials, and product details accurately.



7. Using Vela to create, edit, organize, duplicate, and improve listings.



8. Researching competitors, best-selling products, market trends, and customer search behavior.



9. Improving existing Etsy listings through stronger SEO, better titles, clearer descriptions, stronger tags, and better product structure.



10. Creating or preparing text for listing infographics such as size, materials, customization steps, ordering instructions, and what is included.



11. Creating supporting listing graphics in Canva and/or Adobe that help customers understand the product clearly.



12. Creating Pinterest titles, descriptions, and keyword direction to support Etsy traffic.



13. Creating or organizing Pinterest pins and simple social media graphics for product launches.



14. Organizing listing information so each product launch is accurate, complete, and ready to publish.



15. Checking listings carefully for spelling, grammar, formatting, pricing accuracy, product details, personalization instructions, and brand consistency.



16. Communicating clearly each workday about what has been completed, what needs review, and what still needs attention.



17. Learning the Maria Gossard Designs brand voice and helping every listing feel polished, elevated, accurate, and special.



## What This Role Is Not



This is **not** a product design role.



This is **not** a role where you will create the artwork or design the stationery.



This is **not** a photo editing role.



This is **not** a customer service role.



This is **not** a dropshipping operations role.



This is **not** an Amazon-only PPC role.



This is **not** a general VA role.



This is **not** a role for someone who only knows how to make pretty graphics without understanding SEO, product listings, customer clarity, and e-commerce structure.



This role is for someone who knows how to create strong Etsy listings that help beautiful products get found, understood, and purchased.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is smart, organized, honest, detail-oriented, teachable, and highly experienced with Etsy.



You must understand that a winning Etsy listing requires strategy. You should be able to take a finished product and ask:



* What is the buyer searching for?

* What problem, desire, or occasion does this product answer?

* What keywords should this listing target?

* What makes this product special?

* What details does the customer need before buying?

* What should the title, tags, description, and images communicate?

* What infographics would help the customer understand the product?

* How can Pinterest help support visibility for this listing?



We are not looking for someone to audit our shop, redirect our strategy, or tell us what kind of business we should be. We are looking for a strong Etsy listing assistant who can support the development of new listings for products we design and create.



You must be comfortable following instructions, asking smart questions, receiving feedback, making revisions, and working with accuracy.



## Work Standards



We have very high standards and a zero-tolerance approach to mediocrity caused by lack of commitment, poor communication, carelessness, or poor work ethic.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in excellent work, follows through, communicates clearly, and wants to contribute meaningfully to the growth of the brand.



Because this role involves original artwork, product designs, client information, brand assets, and business systems, all work must be completed personally by you. No assignments, files, artwork, passwords, client information, or business materials may be shared with anyone else, including family members, relatives, other assistants, or outside tea
mbers.



## Application Requirements



Please apply only if you are fully qualified and willing to follow the application instructions exactly.



To be considered, your application must include:



1. The phrase **“Soar Online”** in the subject line

2. A written response to the application questions below

3. Examples of Etsy listings you have created or improved

4. Examples of Vela work or a clear explanation of how you have used Vela

5. Examples of Canva, infographic, Adobe, Pinterest, or social media graphics you have created

6. Confirmation that you understand and accept the posted compensation and schedule



Applications that do not include the required subject line phrase, written answers, relevant work examples, Vela experience, and compensation/schedule confirmation will not be considered.



Applicants without Vela experience and at least 3 years of hands-on Etsy platform experience will not be considered.



## Written Application Questions



Please answer the following in writing:



1. How many years of hands-on Etsy platform experience do you have?



2. How many Etsy listings have you created or improved?



3. What kinds of products have you created Etsy listings for?



4. Have you used Vela to create, edit, duplicate, or optimize Etsy listings? Please explain exactly what tasks you have completed inside Vela.



5. Describe your Etsy keyword research process.



6. What tools do you use for Etsy SEO and keyword research?



7. How do you write Etsy titles?



8. How do you choose Etsy tags?



9. How do you structure an Etsy product description?



10. Have you completed Etsy categories, attributes, variations, and personalization fields?



11. Have you used Pinterest to support Etsy traffic?



12. Are you experienced with Canva?



13. Are you experienced with Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop?



14. Can you create Etsy listing infographics, “What’s Included” graphics, size guides, product feature callouts, personalization instruction graphics, and ordering process graphics?



15. Please share examples of Etsy listings you have created or improved.



16. Please share examples of Vela work or explain how you have used Vela for Etsy listing management.



17. Please share examples of infographics, Canva graphics, Adobe graphics, Pinterest pins, or product listing visuals you have created.



18. Do you understand that this is not a product design role, but an Etsy listing development role for products already designed by Maria Gossard Designs?



19. Do you understand and accept the starting compensation of **$200 per week for 40 hours**?



20. Are you available to work **Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time** during the initial onboarding period?



21. Are you currently working for any other clients or employers? If yes, how many hours per week?



22. Do you personally complete all assigned work yourself, or do you ever outsource tasks to others?



23. Why do you think you are a good fit for Maria Gossard Designs?



## Final Step



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit may be asked to complete a small paid test project before a final hiring decision is made. The test may include creating or improving part of an Etsy listing, suggesting keywords, writing a product description, creating listing infographic copy, or creating a simple Canva listing graphic.



## Final Note



Only fully qualified applicants should apply.



We are looking for a long-term assistant who knows Etsy, understands SEO, knows how to use Vela, writes excellent listings, creates helpful listing infographics, follows instructions carefully, and wants to help a luxury brand grow online.



If you are truly an Etsy listing expert who can take a finished product and create a winning listing, we would love to hear from you.

title: Architectural Draftsman 3D Rendering Specialist Luxury Residential Project
description:
# Architectural Draftsman & 3D Rendering Specialist for Luxury Residential New Build



We are looking for a highly skilled **Architectural Draftsman and 3D Rendering Specialist** to assist with a luxury residential new-build project.



This role is ideal for someone who has strong experience creating architectural drawings, interior elevations, 3D models, and realistic renderings for high-end residential homes. We need someone who can take floor plans, design direction, inspiration images, sketches, measurements, and notes, then turn them into clear, accurate, beautiful visuals that help the client, designer, contractors, cabinet makers, and vendors understand the design.



This is a remote position, but you must be able to communicate clearly, follow detailed instructions, meet deadlines, and revise drawings based on feedback.



## About the Project



This is a large custom residential new-build project with luxury interiors, custom cabinetry, specialty rooms, architectural details, and high-end finishes.



The home includes custom spaces such as closets, bars, bathrooms, millwork, cabinetry, specialty furniture pieces, stonework, lighting, and other interior architectural elements. The work requires accuracy, proportion, elegance, and the ability to understand luxury residential design.



We are not looking for basic generic renderings. We need someone who understands scale, detail, materiality, cabinetry, lighting, elevations, and refined residential presentation.



## Position Type



Project-based to start, with the opportunity for ongoing work if the fit is strong.



This may grow into steady part-time or long-term project work depending on skill level, communication, accuracy, and turnaround time.



## Required Skills



Please apply only if you have strong experience with:



* Architectural drafting

* 3D modeling

* 3D renderings

* Interior elevations

* Custom cabinetry drawings

* Residential floor plans

* Luxury residential interiors

* Millwork and built-in details

* Furniture layout and spatial planning

* Accurate measurements and scale

* Materials, finishes, lighting, and realistic presentation

* Revising drawings based on feedback



## Software Experience



Please list the software you use. Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



* AutoCAD

* SketchUp

* Revit

* Chief Architect

* 3ds Max

* Lumion

* Enscape

* V-Ray

* D5 Render

* Twinmotion

* Blender

* Photoshop

* Adobe Illustrator



You do not need to know every program, but you must be able to produce accurate, professional drawings and high-quality 3D visuals.



## Responsibilities



Responsibilities may include:



1. Creating 3D models from floor plans, sketches, measurements, and design direction.



2. Creating interior renderings for luxury residential spaces.



3. Drafting interior elevations for cabinetry, built-ins, vanities, closets, bars, and specialty rooms.



4. Translating design ideas into clear visual presentations for clients and contractors.



5. Preparing drawings that show scale, proportion, layout, materials, and design intent.



6. Creating visuals for custom cabinetry, furniture, stone, lighting, mirrors, doors, and architectural details.



7. Revising models and renderings based on feedback.



8. Organizing files clearly and providing final files in requested formats.



9. Communicating progress and asking smart questions when information is missing.



10. Working efficiently while maintaining accuracy and visual quality.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented

* Accurate with measurements and scale

* Experienced in luxury residential design

* Comfortable working from notes, sketches, floor plans, and reference images

* Able to interpret design direction

* Strong in 3D modeling and rendering

* Organized and deadline-driven

* Honest about what they can and cannot do

* Comfortable making revisions

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Reliable and professional



The right person must have both technical drafting skill and a good visual eye. This project requires someone who can create drawings that are useful for construction conversations, vendor coordination, and client presentations.



## Important Notes



This is not a role for someone who only creates decorative mood boards.



This is not a role for someone who only does basic 3D room mockups.



This is not a role for someone who cannot work accurately with dimensions, cabinetry, elevations, and floor plans.



We need someone who can help us visualize and refine real custom residential spaces.



## Application Instructions



Please apply with the subject line:



**Luxury Residential Drafting**



In your application, please include:



1. Your years of experience in architectural drafting and 3D rendering.



2. The software programs you use.



3. Examples of residential floor plans, elevations, 3D models, or renderings you have created.



4. Examples of custom cabinetry, closets, bars, bathrooms, millwork, or built-in drawings if available.



5. Your experience with luxury residential projects.



6. Your availability and typical turnaround time.



7. Your preferred hourly rate or project rate.



8. Whether you are available for ongoing project-based work.



9. A brief explanation of why you would be a good fit for a luxury residential new-build project.



Applications without relevant architectural drafting or 3D rendering examples will not be considered.



## Final Note



We are looking for a skilled, reliable, detail-oriented drafting and 3D rendering professional who can help bring luxury residential design ideas to life with accuracy, beauty, and clarity.



If you have experience with high-end residential interiors, custom cabinetry, architectural details, and 3D visualization, we would love to see your work.

title: Senior Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve)
