About Alite Creative:

At Alite Creative, we believe great businesses deserve to be seen.

We partner with builders, designers, architects, and other project-based businesses to help them become recognised, trusted leaders in their industry.

Our work goes far beyond creating beautiful videos. We help business owners step confidently into the spotlight, communicate what makes them different, and build the kind of trust that attracts better clients, top talent, and long-term growth.



Every piece of content we create has a purpose. Whether it's a 30-second Reel or a long-form interview, we're always asking:

"How do we help this founder become the obvious choice?"

That's why we're looking for more than just a video editor.

We want someone who understands storytelling. Someone who knows how to find the 
nts that matter, shape emotion, create 
ntum, and produce content that keeps people watching.

If you love creating videos that don't just look great but actually make people feel something, we'd love to hear from you.



The Opportunity:

You'll be joining a growing photography & Videography business, producing premium content for builders, designers, architects, and other project-based businesses.

Much of the footage you'll work with is interviews with business owners, project walkthroughs, client stories, educational content, and behind-the-scenes videos.

Our clients aren't influencers reading scripts.

They're experienced business owners sharing years of knowledge, craftsmanship, and leadership.

Your job is to identify the strongest 
nts, tell compelling stories, and create content that builds trust.

Every edit should feel polished, intentional, and worthy of representing premium brands.



What You'll Be Doing:

- You'll be responsible for editing approximately 5-10 video assets each week, including:

- Scroll-stopping Instagram Reels and short-form videos

- Founder interviews

- Highlight videos

- Educational training content

- Paid advertising creatives

- Client testimonials

- Longer-form storytelling content



You'll also:

- Pull out 3-5 engaging standalone clips from each long-form video using our content markers.

- Design strong opening hooks that capture attention immediately.

- Add captions, motion graphics, B-roll, transitions, music, sound design, and colour grading where appropriate.

- Maintain a consistent editing style across all client work.

- Follow our templates, workflows, and brand guidelines (full training will be provided).

- Provide a thumbnail image or screen grab for every completed edit.

- Collaborate with our team through video calls,
, Notion, and ClickUp.

- Deliver projects on time while maintaining an exceptional standard of quality.



What Great Looks Like - You may be a great fit if you:

- Think about the story before the effects.

- Know how to hook viewers within the first few seconds.

- Understand pacing and audience retention.

- Can watch a 30-minute interview and quickly identify the most compelling 
nts.

- Know when to let emotion breathe instead of over-editing.

- Have a strong eye for detail and consistency.

- Enjoy receiving feedback and continually improving your work.

- Take genuine pride in producing premium-quality edits.



We're not looking for someone who simply assembles clips.

We're looking for someone who understands that every video represents a business owner, their business, and years of hard work.

Your edits should help people trust them before they ever pick up the phone.



Essential Requirements - To succeed in this role you'll need:

- Strong experience editing in DaVinci Resolve.

- A portfolio demonstrating both short-form and long-form editing.

- Excellent storytelling ability.

- Confidence creating engaging social media content.

- Experience editing interview-style videos.

- Strong English communication skills and confidence joining video calls.

- Excellent organisational skills.

- A reliable internet connection.

- A computer capable of editing high-resolution video efficiently.

- A positive attitude and willingness to learn.



Bonus Skills - While not essential, we'd love it if you also have experience with:

- Real estate, construction, architecture, or design industry content.

- Paid advertising creatives.

- Motion graphics.

- Basic graphic design.

- AI-assisted editing workflows.

- YouTube editing and audience retention strategies.



What Success Looks Like - Within your first 90 days you'll be:

- Producing polished edits that require minimal revisions.

- Confidently following our editing style and workflows.

- Creating engaging Reels that consistently capture attention.

- Editing long-form content that tells meaningful stories.

- Helping our clients build trust through exceptional content.

- Becoming an important part of a collaborative creative team.



Why This Role Matters:

Most people think editing is about making videos look good.

We see it differently.

Every business owner we work with has spent years building a business they're proud of.

Our job is to help the world see the quality, leadership, and care that's already there.

As our Video Editor, you'll play a huge role in helping great businesses become recognised leaders in their industry.

Your work won't just generate views.

It will build trust, shape perception, strengthen brands, and help our clients win more of the right opportunities.

If that excites you, you'll fit right in.



Why Join Alite Creative?

We're building something special.

We're creating content that genuinely helps business owners grow, and we're looking for people who care about quality as much as we do.



When you join our team, you'll receive:

- Long-term, consistent work.

- Ongoing feedback and support.

- Training.

- Opportunities to develop your skills.

- A collaborative, friendly team environment.

- Interesting projects across a range of premium businesses.

- We value craftsmanship, creativity, initiative, and people who genuinely care about producing their best work.



How to Apply - To be considered for this position, kindly respond to this Job Offer with the following (all elements must be completed to be considered):

-
: 

- Attach your resume

- Include a brief cover letter

- Send a 2-minute Loom video explaining:

- Who you are

- Examples of previous support roles you’ve worked in/on

- Subject line: It’s “[Your Name]” the [Role Title] you’ve been looking for

- Include the date and time you're sending your application

- Fill out this form: 
 



Important: Failure to complete the form will result in the exclusion of your application.

We're looking for someone who genuinely cares about creating outstanding work, not someone simply trying to edit videos as quickly as possible.



If you're passionate about storytelling, take pride in your craft, and want to help premium businesses become recognised leaders in their industry, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Automation Platform - DEVELOPER
description:
I'm building an internal web platform that turns a script into a finished YouTube video automatically.

I want to upload a script, select a saved AI character (avatar) and voice, and click Create. The system then automatically via API:



Generates the voiceover

Generates AI avatar footage of the character speaking the script

Pulls matching stock b-roll for each scene

Assembles the complete edited video (avatar intro, b-roll body, split-screen segments) — no human editor



These channels are the output format and quality we're building toward. Watch a few videos before applying:















Dashboard steps & capabilities:

Script upload ? automatic scene breakdown with timestamps and b-roll keywords (LLM API)

Character library — save avatars per channel + create new ones (AI image ? animated talking avatar)

Voice library — saved voices per character

Auto-pull b-roll from Pexels/Pixabay APIs matched to each scene

Auto-generate avatar footage speaking the script (typically the opening minutes + transitions, not the full runtime)

Auto-assemble the final video following editing rules (avatar open ? b-roll ? split-screen ? avatar close)

Render queue, project history, per-video cost tracking



Requirements:



Total generation cost must land around $3-5 per video (15–20 min videos). Fully automated end-to-end — script in, video out. A simple review screen to swap clips before final render is a plus.



Relevant skills: FFmpeg / programmatic video assembly, AI media pipelines (ComfyUI, Replicate, fal.ai, RunPod), TTS and image/video generation APIs, full-stack web development.

How would you build this, layer by layer, with the specific tools you'd use and cost per video?

Timeline to a working v1?

title: Video Editor — Clean YouTube Long-Form + Punchy Short-Form Reels
description:
I'm looking for a reliable video editor for two content streams. One is a premium but un-monetized, B2B education-style YouTube channel. The other is short-form vertical videos for a large Instagram audience (375k+ followers). I keep my edits minimal, so taste and a clean eye matter to me more than flashy effects.



**Stream 1 — YouTube long-form (minimal, beautiful, clean)**

These are talking-head videos. The edits are light: cut the retakes and mistakes, and place clean, well-positioned text on screen where it helps the viewer. The look should feel premium and elegant, like a high-end briefing, not a typical YouTube video. If you can make simple look beautiful, you'll do great here. No jump-cut spam, no meme effects, no loud zoom-punches.



**Stream 2 — short-form vertical (Reels, 45 sec to 1:15)**

Fast, engaging vertical videos for Instagram, roughly 2–3 Reels per week. Here I want you to add the cuts, b-roll, sound effects, text overlays, graphics, and timing that make a Reel land. I have an existing style but I'm open to fresh ideas. 

Note: I choose the background music and add my own captions, so you don't need to do either of those. Most videos run 45 seconds to 1:15 and rarely go longer.



What you handle: cutting, on-screen text (long-form), cuts + sound effects + pacing (short-form), clean exports.

What I handle: background music and captions on short-form, plus the final creative calls.



You're a fit if you:

- Have real editing samples, ideally both clean talking-head/educational work and punchy short-form

- Have a strong eye for clean typography and restraint

- Communicate clearly and hit deadlines

- Want steady, ongoing weekly work (about 2–3 Reels a week plus the YouTube long-form)



How to apply (read carefully, I will skip any application that ignores this):

1. Make your subject have thew word **SCHOLAR** in it somewhere so I know you read the whole post.



2. Send 2–3 portfolio samples. Include at least one clean/minimal edit and one short-form vertical if you have them.



3. Answer these three:

   - What do you use for clean on-screen typography and text?

   - Are you comfortable working in Frame.io, Notion, Capcut/Descript etc?

   - How do you avoid frame-rate problems in your edits and exports?



4. Tell me your rate (per video or monthly) and your typical turnaround time.



Applications that complete all four steps go to the top of my list.

description:
Role Fractional Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Type Independent Contractor — Part-Time

Location Remote — Philippines

Hours 15–20 hrs/week, night shift to align with EST (Ottawa, Canada) — flexible block scheduling

Pay $400–$550 USD/month base (pro-rated hourly or per-block) + performance bonuses per qualified demo booked

Start Date ASAP



About Velogics

Velogics is an Ottawa-based AI automation agency. We build done-for-you AI systems that help small businesses respond to leads in 47 seconds or less — turning missed calls and slow follow-ups into booked appointments.

Our clients are trades businesses, real estate agents, dental clinics, mortgage brokers, and insurance companies across Canada. We're early stage, growing fast, and we want our first SDR to grow with us.



The Role

Velogics is looking for a fractional SDR — a part-time outbound specialist who can dedicate focused, dedicated hours each week to building our pipeline. This is ideal if you're already working with one other client and have 15–20 hours/week of capacity, or if you want to start part-time with the door open to full-time as we scale.

Your job is simple: find the right small business owners in our target markets, start conversations, and book qualified demo calls for our sales team.



This is a cold outreach role. You will be on the phone. You will be sending
s. You will be messaging on LinkedIn. You don’t close — you open doors.



What You’ll Do

• Cold call SMB owners in Ottawa and across Canada (trades, real estate, dental, mortgage, insurance)

• Send personalized cold
s using our GoHighLevel sequences

• Prospect and message leads on LinkedIn

• Qualify inbound and outbound leads against our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)

• Book demo calls and hand them off to our closer (Sami)

• Log all activity in our CRM (GoHighLevel) — every call,
, and outcome

• Hit weekly KPI targets scaled to your hours: dials, connect rate, and demos booked

• Attend a 15-minute weekly coaching call to review call recordings and performance



What We’re Looking For

• 1–3 years of outbound SDR or appointment-setting experience, B2B preferred

• Strong spoken English — you will be calling Canadian small business owners

• Experience with cold calling — you need to be comfortable picking up the phone

• Familiar with CRM tools (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar)

• Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline without hand-holding

• Available for 15–20 hrs/week within North American EST business hours (night shift PHT) — we'll agree on a consistent weekly schedule together

• Comfortable splitting time with other clients, as long as Velogics gets dedicated, scheduled blocks

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet place to make calls



Nice to Have

• Experience selling to trades, dental, real estate, or other SMB verticals

• Familiarity with AI tools or SaaS products

• Experience with Apollo.io or other prospecting platforms



What You Get

• $400–$550 USD/month base for 15–20 hrs/week (paid twice monthly via Wise) — or a flat per-block/per-deliverable rate if you prefer

• Performance bonus: $10–$15 USD per qualified demo booked — no cap

• Night shift premium for EST hours coverage

• Full onboarding: scripts, ICP docs, call recordings, playbook

• Direct access to founders — no layers of management

• Clear path to full-time: as our outbound pipeline scales, top fractional performers get first right of refusal on a full-time SDR or senior SDR role



How to Apply

Send the following to 
 with subject line: Fractional SDR Application — [Your Name]



• Your CV or LinkedIn profile

• A 2–3 minute Loom or voice recording: introduce yourself and tell us why you’re a great fit for a cold outreach role

• One example of a cold call or outreach sequence you’ve run (describe it — what was the ICP, what was your opener, what results did you get)



Applications without a voice or video recording will not be reviewed. We need to hear how you communicate before we move forward.

title: Lead Magnet Creator / Content Operator
description:
Senior Content and Automation Assistant



BlueMoso | Remote (Philippines-based only) | Part-time with full-time potential

Location: Philippines only

Schedule: EST hours, flexible

Monthly Rate: USD $440 - $704

Start date: Within 1-2 Weeks

Employment type: Part-time (20 hours per week) with Full-time Potential



ABOUT BLUEMOSO

BlueMoso is a virtual staffing agency that places virtual assistants with business owners and leaders globally. We don't just match and disappear. We vet obsessively, set both sides up to win, and stay involved long after the placement is made.





ABOUT THE ROLE

BlueMoso is hiring on behalf of a founder who runs a lead generation business and two SaaS products. They are looking for one person to take over creating lead magnets and the text-based content that distributes them. This is not a "post when you feel like it" gig. They want someone who can own the engine.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO

– Build lead magnets (guides, playbooks, swipe files, tools) that people trade their
 for.

– Write and ship text + image content for LinkedIn, X, and other social platforms.

– Watch what's trending and move fast. If there's a wave, you're already on it before they ask



WHO THEY'RE LOOKING FOR

– AI-native. You don't "use ChatGPT sometimes." You build with AI. It's how you think and how you move 10x faster than people who don't.

– Grit. You finish. You ship daily. You don't disappear when something gets hard or boring.

– Fearless. You're not precious about your ideas and you're not scared to jump on a trend, ride a bandwagon, or look try-hard. The people who win at content are the ones who aren't afraid to.

– Self-directed. You get the goal, not the steps. You figure out the rest and report back on what you did.



NICE TO HAVE

A track record of viral or high-performing text-based content on X, LinkedIn, or anywhere else. If you've made something blow up, show it. But honestly, the AI skill matters more. The content craft can be taught.



HOW TO APPLY

Read carefully. This is the filter. 



– Loom Video: Send a Loom (5 minutes max) where you screen-share and walk us through the single coolest thing you've ever built with AI. We want to see how you think and what you're capable of, not hear you describe yourself. 

– Resume: Your most current resume. 

– Written Note: In your written note, include the words "I ride waves" so we know you read this far. Applications without this will be skipped. 



Send everything to 



Show us. Don't tell us.

title: Quality Assurance Nurse
description:
About the Position

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join our Quality Assurance (QA) team as a Hospice Documentation Auditor. This is a fully remote position responsible for reviewing and auditing hospice clinical documentation to ensure compliance with hospice documentation best practices.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, possesses excellent critical thinking skills, and has extensive knowledge of hospice documentation standards. This role plays a vital part in ensuring that our clinical records accurately reflect each patient's condition, support hospice eligibility, and withstand regulatory audits.



Primary Responsibilities

Review and audit hospice nursing documentation for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

Identify documentation errors, omissions, inconsistencies, and contradictions within the medical record.

Ensure documentation accurately reflects the patient's clinical decline and disease progression.

Verify that visit notes clearly describe the patient's current condition, symptom burden, functional status, and changes from previous visits.

Ensure documentation effectively answers the question: "Why Hospice Now?" by painting a clear and defensible picture of the patient's terminal illness and ongoing decline.

Review admission, routine, PRN, recertification, discharge, and other hospice documentation for quality and compliance.

Confirm that documentation supports the patient's terminal prognosis and continued eligibility for hospice services.

Identify missing documentation, conflicting information, or incomplete assessments that could place claims at risk during 

Return documentation requiring corrections to clinicians with clear, concise QA feedback.

Collaborate with nursing leadership to improve documentation quality and consistency.

Monitor documentation trends and recommend opportunities for education and process improvement.

Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA requirements.

Qualifications

Required

Active Registered Nurse (RN) license (license does not have to be from the state where the hospice operates).

Strong understanding of hospice eligibility guidelines and documentation requirements.

Excellent written English communication skills.

Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and provide constructive feedback.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Proficient computer skills.

title: AI UGC/ANIMATION VIDEO EDITOR 3k/m
description:
AI Video Editor / AI Creative Specialist for 8 Figure Ecommerce Brand



We are ClarityMD, an 8 figure direct response ecommerce brand in the health and wellness space.



We are looking for a highly skilled AI Video Editor / AI Creative Specialist who can create high performing direct response ads using advanced AI video tools.



This role is not for a basic editor. We are looking for someone who already understands AI video production, direct response advertising, ecommerce creatives, and how to make ads that actually get people to stop scrolling, watch, click, and buy. DONT APPLY IF YOU DONT HAVE A PORTFOLIO



## Main Tools and Skills We Are Looking For



You should be highly proficient with tools such as:



Veo 3

Flow

Higgsfield

Seedance

Runway

Kling

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar editing software



We are also open to investing in other AI tools and software if you can prove they will help improve output quality, speed, or performance.



## The Style of Ads We Need



We are mainly looking for someone who can create:



1. AI animation style ads

This includes cartoon style ads, Pixar inspired animation style ads, cinematic animated scenes, character driven animation, and engaging storytelling style visuals.



2. Realistic AI UGC ads

This includes realistic AI avatars, AI doctors, AI customer testimonials, selfie style videos, natural talking head videos, and believable direct response UGC content.



3. Health, skin, wellness, and direct response ecommerce ads

You must understand how to create ads for brands that sell products online, especially in health, skincare, supplements, wellness, or similar spaces.



If you have not worked with direct response ecommerce brands before, especially brands focused on aggressive performance marketing, this role is probably not a fit.



## Responsibilities



Create high quality AI video ads based on briefs provided by our team



Produce realistic AI UGC videos, AI doctor style videos, animated ads, and direct response creatives



Work from clear scripts, hooks, references, and creative briefs



Use AI tools to create characters, scenes, motion, voice, pacing, b roll, and final edited videos



Understand how to make videos feel real, native, emotional, and performance driven



Hit deadlines consistently without needing constant chasing



Communicate any problems, delays, or blockers in advance



Join a biweekly team call for creative feedback, updates, and training



Work Monday to Friday



Stay organized and responsive with the team



## Workload



You will receive around 8 to 12 briefs per week.



You should be able to handle at least 2 briefs per day, depending on complexity.



Most briefs will be around 3 to 4 minutes in length, including AI footage, voiceover, editing, pacing, captions, b roll, and final delivery.



We care about speed, but quality matters. We are looking for someone who can move fast while still creating content that feels real, polished, and built for direct response performance.



## Requirements



Must have a portfolio of AI video ads



Must have examples of animation style ads, cartoon style ads, or Pixar inspired AI ads



Must have examples of realistic AI UGC or talking head videos



Must have experience working with direct response ecommerce brands



Experience in health, skincare, supplements, wellness, or similar industries is strongly preferred



Must understand hooks, pacing, retention, scroll stopping visuals, and conversion focused editing



Must be able to follow briefs closely without going off direction



Must be reliable, communicative, and deadline focused



Must be open to feedback and willing to improve quickly



Must be looking for a long term role



## Compensation



You can earn up to $2,000 per month working with us, depending on experience, output, quality, and reliability.



There is also room for incentives and performance based bonuses.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the brand long term. We will provide training, creative direction, references, and feedback to help you improve your skills and produce better ads.



## How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio

2. Examples of AI animation style ads you have made

3. Examples of realistic AI UGC ads you have made

4. A list of AI tools you are strongest with

5. Brands you have worked with, especially direct response ecommerce brands

6. . Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday and handle 8 to 12 briefs per week



Please do not apply if you only have basic editing experience.



We are specifically looking for someone experienced in AI video production, direct response ecommerce ads, realistic AI UGC, and animation style AI ads.

title: Video Editor & Content Strategist: Personal Brand (Yacht Industry)
description:
About the Project

I'm a yacht advisor building a personal brand presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts. I have approximately 45 minutes of high-end editorial B-roll footage shot on a yacht, plus a complete brand identity book (colors, typography, tone of voice). I need someone who can turn this raw footage into a library of short-form video content and carousel posts ready to publish.

To find out a little about my work visit my website: 



What You'll Do

Review 45 minutes of raw footage and identify the strongest 
nts

Develop reel concepts and content ideas tailored to each platform .

Edit short-form videos (Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn video) including: closed captions, transitions, music selection, color grading adjustments

Create carousel posts combining photos and short video clips (photos extracted from the footage or provided by me)

Write captions and hooks for each piece of content

Deliver final files formatted for each platform, ready to publish

Ensure all content is aligned with the existing brand identity (PDF provided)



Deliverables

Short-form video clips optimized for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

Carousel posts (photos + short video clips) for Instagram and LinkedIn

Captions and hooks for each video and carousel

All edits polished and on-brand (CC, transitions, music, pacing, visual consistency across carousel slides)



Requirements

Strong portfolio of short-form content editing and carousel design, Experience with luxury or premium brands is required. Applicants without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

Ability to think strategically about content, not just execute edits

Understanding of platform-specific best practices (aspect ratios, pacing, hook timing, carousel sequencing)

Reliable communication and fast turnaround

How to Apply

To be considered, submit the following to Ximena Castro at  
 

1- A link to your portfolio or relevant work samples

2- A 30-second sample video using the footage and brand identity materials I provide (5-minute footage clip + brand identity PDF will be shared with applicants)

3- A brief note on your approach: what you'd do with the content and why



Applications that do not include all items listed above will not be reviewed.



Why Apply

This is a project-based role with a strong possibility of becoming a permanent position for the right person. If we work well together, there's ongoing content to create.



Project pay is $400–$600 depending on experience and portfolio strength. Payment will be structured in two milestones: 50% upon approval of the first content batch, and 50% upon final delivery of all assets. This project has strong potential to become an ongoing role — the right candidate will have first consideration for continued work.

title: Home Care Administrative Manager
description:
A Better Solution In Home Care is a well-established and growing private-duty home care agency seeking an looking for an administrative manager to join our team. This is a high-pressure, fast-paced role that serves as the backbone of our daily operations and is best suited for someone who thrives under pressure, enjoys problem-solving, and can confidently manage multiple priorities at once. 

The primary focus of this position is scheduling and staffing, including managing call-offs, filling open shifts, handling last-minute scheduling emergencies, resolving scheduling conflicts, and ensuring our clients receive uninterrupted care. The ideal candidate will have prior home care scheduling experience, strong communication and conflict resolution skills, and the ability to think critically and make sound decisions in real time. Experience with SwyftOps scheduling software is a strong plus, but not a requirement. In addition to scheduling responsibilities, this individual will answer incoming phone calls and text messages, professionally assist callers, and direct inquiries to the appropriate department when needed. They may also assist with client intake calls, hiring support, and other administrative tasks as assigned. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to remain calm and solution-focused during stressful situations. 

Our clients and caregivers rely on us every day, and we are looking for someone who understands the urgency and responsibility that comes with coordinating care in a demanding home care environment. Candidates seeking a slower-paced administrative position should not apply, as this role requires a strong work ethic, adaptability, accountability, and the ability to excel in a high-volume, high-demand scheduling environment where no two days are ever the same. Merit-based wage increases are available at 90 days, 6 months, and annually for employees who demonstrate strong performance and contribute to the continued success of our team

Being located near Manila is a plus.

Following that, we will provide training on our operations along with foundational knowledge of insurance.

title: Job Description: Senior Paralegal Virtual Assistant — Evidence & Case Strategy Specialist
description:
________________________________________

Job Description: Senior Paralegal Virtual Assistant — Evidence & Case Strategy Specialist

Long-Term Full-Time Remote Role (Philippines) Full-time schedule partially aligned with U.S. Mountain Time business hours

________________________________________

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-obsessed, and deeply committed paralegal virtual assistant to join our team in the Philippines. This is a full-time, six-month minimum contract role with strong potential for extension. You will be the right hand to a busy professional navigating multiple simultaneous legal matters stemming from a documented, decade-long campaign of harassment, stalking, defamation, and abuse of legal process by a former partner.

This is NOT a "general VA" role.

This is not typical administrative work. We need a strategic thinker — someone who can walk into chaos, impose order, and emerge with crystal-clear evidence packets that tell a compelling story to judges, attorneys, licensing boards, and investigators. You will become intimately familiar with domestic violence, coercive control, abuse of process, and malicious prosecution law.

If you have a passion for justice, a particular commitment to women's rights and survivor advocacy, and the kind of mind that finds satisfaction in turning tangled evidence into airtight, beautifully organized case files — this role was built for you.

This role is ideal for someone who:

• enjoys organizing chaos

• notices small details others miss

• communicates with warmth, precision, and authority

• likes deep, focused work for long stretches

• thinks strategically and can prioritize under pressure

• can gently but confidently keep people on track

• has heart and stamina for emotionally difficult material

We are looking for someone reliable, proactive, calm under pressure, and highly consistent.

This is a long-term position with growth potential.

________________________________________

Compensation



• $750–$1,000 USD/monthly depending on experience

• Full-time, with paid holidays

• Stable long-term role

• Performance-based growth opportunities over time

Long-term stability with a professional employer who values and respects her team

________________________________________



Required Schedule

• Monday through Friday

• Partial alignment with U.S. Mountain Standard Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM MST)

• Full-time position — you must be available and responsive during your set working hours

• Flexibility to adjust hours occasionally for meetings with U.S.-based counsel as needed

This role works best for someone with:

• minimal household interruptions

• stable internet

• quiet, private work environment

• ability to focus for long periods

• ability to maintain strict confidentiality

________________________________________

What You'll Be Working On

You will be supporting six concurrent legal matters, all interconnected through a single pattern of harassment by the employer's ex-partner:

1. Criminal Defense Case False criminal allegations have been repeatedly brought forward. You will help organize timeline evidence, identify patterns of retaliatory false reporting, and build documentation demonstrating the coordinated nature of these allegations.

2. Family Law Case False allegations of child abuse have been made in family court proceedings. You will help assemble communication records, prior court filings, and behavioral documentation that establish the retaliatory and fabricated nature of these claims. Understanding of coercive control dynamics is essential here.

3. Employment Law Case (Husband's Matter) The employer's husband has been falsely accused of theft by his employer — an allegation believed to be connected to the same harassment campaign. You will help organize employment records, communications, and circumstantial evidence linking the accusation to the broader pattern.

4. Nursing License Defense False allegations have been filed against the employer's professional license with the licensing board. You will help prepare board-ready evidence packets, compile character and professional references, and document the timing relationship between these allegations and other retaliatory actions.

5. Asset Protection Work Assist with organizing and supporting the creation of a revocable trust and related asset protection structures. This involves coordinating with legal counsel, preparing document checklists, and ensuring all filings and records are properly maintained.

6. Defamation & Abuse of Process Case Preparation (Future Litigation) The long-term goal is to build a civil case for defamation, abuse of process, and malicious prosecution. You will begin compiling the foundational evidence trail — documenting every instance of false police reports, baseless complaints, regulatory referrals, and public defamation — to build a master timeline and pattern-of-conduct dossier that demonstrates a sustained, coordinated campaign lasting over a decade.

Additionally: IRS Audit Defense The employer has been subjected to repeated IRS audits believed to stem from false reports. You will help organize tax records, correspondence with the IRS, and documentation establishing the suspicious pattern and frequency of these audits.

________________________________________

Primary Responsibilities

Evidence Management & Organization

• Sort, categorize, and chronologically organize a large volume of evidence across all case areas, including
s, text messages, call logs, police reports, court filings, financial records, social media posts, screenshots, audio recordings, and affidavits

• Create clean, professional, easy-to-read evidence packets with clear indexing, tabbing, and cross-referencing so that any attorney or judge can quickly navigate and understand the material

• Build master timelines and relationship maps that visually connect events, allegations, and actors across all cases

• Identify gaps in evidence and proactively recommend what additional documentation may strengthen each case

• Maintain a centralized, secure digital case management system with consistent naming conventions, tagging, and retrieval systems so any document can be located instantly

• Redact and format documents appropriately for legal submission

• Develop visual aids such as relationship maps, chronological flowcharts, and pattern-of-conduct matrices where helpful

Legal Research & Case Strategy

• Conduct legal research on domestic violence, coercive control, stalking, harassment, defamation, abuse of process, and malicious prosecution — becoming a subject matter expert over time

• Research relevant U.S. statutes, case law, and procedural rules applicable to each matter

• Draft case summaries, legal memoranda, and strategy briefs that help prioritize next steps and identify strengths and weaknesses

• Monitor filing deadlines, statute of limitations, and court procedural requirements across all active matters

• Develop and maintain a strategy dashboard showing the status, priorities, and upcoming actions for each case

Pattern Documentation & Smear Campaign Analysis

• Systematically document the 10-year pattern of harassment, false police reports, false child welfare complaints, false licensing board complaints, and IRS audit triggers

• Build a "pattern of conduct" master file demonstrating the coordinated, retaliatory nature of the opposing party's actions across multiple institutions

• Prepare materials that clearly illustrate how false allegations recur across different venues (police, employers, licensing boards, tax authorities) — essential to the planned abuse-of-process and malicious prosecution litigation

Cross-Case Coordination

• Maintain a centralized, secure, and well-organized digital case management system

• Ensure evidence relevant to multiple cases is tagged and accessible across matters without duplication

• Coordinate with retained attorneys by preparing organized briefing materials, evidence binders, and chronologies ahead of meetings, hearings, and depositions

• Track all attorney communications, deadlines, and deliverables

Asset Protection Support

• Assist with organizing financial documents and disclosures needed for the creation of a revocable trust

• Help compile records of assets, liabilities, and ownership structures

• Heavy research into strategy for privacy and compliance requirements

• Coordinate with any estate planning professionals as needed

________________________________________

This Role Is NOT

• General virtual assistant work

• Receptionist or phone support

• Sales or marketing

• Social media management

• Data entry only

• A stepping stone — we want someone who will commit and stay

You will NOT be expected to handle public-facing communication.

Most work is research, writing, evidence organization, and strategy.

________________________________________

Ideal Personality

You may be a great fit if:

• you naturally notice small mistakes

• you like checklists, systems, and organization

• you enjoy deep, focused work done thoroughly

• you are dependable and emotionally steady

• you communicate warmly and professionally but with authority

• you are proactive without being aggressive

• you can confidently keep tasks moving forward

• you enjoy helping busy people stay organized

• you have genuine heart for justice and women's advocacy

• you are resilient when exposed to difficult, emotionally charged material

A little "bossy" in a helpful, organized way is actually a positive for this role.

________________________________________

Required Qualifications

• Paralegal certificate or equivalent legal studies degree (preferably from a recognized Philippine institution)

• Minimum 3–5 years of paralegal or legal assistant experience, ideally in litigation, family law, criminal defense, or civil law

• Strong understanding of legal terminology, court procedures, evidence rules, and legal document preparation

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously without losing track of details

________________________________________

Essential Skills

• Excellent written English (natural, professional tone with clarity and polish)

• Exceptional organizational abilities — you bring order to chaos instinctively and enjoy doing it

• Advanced document management — proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and cloud-based file organization; experience with legal case management software (e.g., Clio, MyCase, or similar) is a strong plus

• Strong writing skills — ability to draft clear, concise, professional summaries, memos, and correspondence that are pleasing to read and hold attention

• Analytical thinking — ability to spot connections between seemingly unrelated pieces of evidence and identify patterns over time

• Research skills — comfort conducting legal research using online databases and synthesizing findings into actionable summaries

• Discretion and confidentiality — absolute commitment to maintaining the privacy and security of sensitive legal and personal information

• Tech-savvy — comfortable with project management tools (e.g., Notion, Trello, Asana), secure file sharing, and virtual collaboration

• Ability to synthesize large amounts of information into simplified, well-structured written summaries with clear direction and argument

• Reliable attendance and responsiveness

________________________________________

Preferred Experience

Strongly preferred:

• Familiarity with U.S. legal systems, particularly family law, criminal procedure, or administrative/license defense proceedings

• Experience documenting domestic violence, coercive control, or stalking cases

• Experience preparing evidence for civil litigation involving defamation, harassment, or tort claims

• Prior experience working remotely for a U.S.-based client or law firm

Bonus:

• Background in investigative work, forensic accounting, or financial document analysis

• Knowledge of trust formation or estate planning basics

• Legal case management software experience

• Experience coordinating multiple complex case timelines simultaneously

________________________________________

Technical Requirements

You must have:

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Backup internet solution preferred

• Quiet, private work environment

• Modern computer

• Ability to remain online and available during full shift

• Secure file storage capability

________________________________________

Important

We are looking for ONE excellent long-term tea
mber.

This is not ideal for:

• applicants juggling many clients

• frequent job-hoppers

• people looking for temporary work

• people who dislike detail-heavy, focused work

• people who cannot commit to Mountain Time business hours

We will not hire from an agency, only individuals.

Reliability, consistency, attention to detail, written communication, and heart matter more to us than flashy resumes.

All work product is confidential and subject to a non-disclosure agreement.

You will be joining an existing virtual team of three Filipino administrative professionals who handle other operational tasks. This role is focused exclusively on legal/paralegal work.

________________________________________

To Apply — Through OnlineJobs.ph Only

Please send the following via OnlineJobs.ph messaging:

1. Your resume/CV highlighting relevant paralegal or legal experience

2. A cover letter (no more than 500 words) explaining why this role appeals to you, your experience with evidence organization or multi-case management, and any connection you feel to the themes of this position

3. A work sample or portfolio if available — e.g., a redacted legal memo, evidence index, case summary, or timeline you have created in a previous role (with all confidential information removed)

4. Your monthly salary expectation

5. Your internet speed screenshot

6. Your availability — earliest start date and preferred working hours

7. A short paragraph answering this question:

"You are given 300 pages of mixed documents — texts,
s, police reports, and financial records — across three different cases that appear unrelated. Walk us through how you would begin organizing this into searchable, court-ready evidence packets."

8. Include the phrase:

"organized evidence tells the story"

in your application so we know you read the full post carefully.

Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. We want to hear your voice and understand your motivation — this role requires heart as much as skill.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a brief written assessment process (four
 exchanges over approximately two weeks) to evaluate writing quality, strategic thinking, and authentic engagement with the material.

ONLY USE THE ONLINEJOBS.PH CHANNEL FOR COMMUNICATION, PLEASE DO NOT RESEARCH AND SEND
S TO PERSONAL ADDRESS.

________________________________________

Final Note

This position is about more than document management. It's about helping a dedicated professional fight back against a decade of harassment and false allegations, protect her family and career, and ultimately seek accountability through the legal system. If you are someone who believes that organized, compelling evidence can be the difference between justice denied and justice served — we want to meet you.

HMO coverage

Leave credits

title: Candidate Onboarding & Success Coordinator
description:
JT Media is a marketing agency that helps healthcare companies recruit qualified caregivers and healthcare professionals. We are looking for a full-time Candidate Onboarding & Success Coordinator to help newly signed candidates successfully complete the hiring process.



This is NOT a cold-calling position, and it is NOT a recruiting role. Every person you work with has already spoken with our recruitment team and agreed to move forward. Your responsibility is to keep candidates engaged, organized, and on track until they have completed every required hiring step.



You will be responsible for ensuring that candidates complete all onboarding requirements while maintaining frequent communication and providing an outstanding experience throughout the process.



Your Primary Responsibilities



Candidate Follow-Up. Maintain regular communication with newly signed candidates by phone, text, and
 to ensure they continue progressing through the hiring process.



Onboarding Coordination. Guide candidates through each required onboarding step, answer questions, and help eliminate delays that could prevent them from being successfully hired.

Employment applications



Background checks

CPR certifications

Tuberculosis (TB) testing

Required documentation

Any additional onboarding tasks required by the client

Uncapped commission

Full-time position (40 hours per week)

We process a high volume of candidates each week, giving top performers the opportunity to earn significant commissions in addition to their base pay.

Your resume (PDF format)

description:
Company: We are TheVault, a seven-figure e-commerce group operating multiple Amazon storefronts that source in coordination, plus active Walmart Marketplace storefronts that accumulate to six-figure in revenue.

About the Role

We are hiring one sharp, profitable Online Arbitrage (OA) product researcher to join a process-driven team of serious sellers. You will source profitable leads daily across Amazon (and occasionally Walmart), vet them against our buying criteria, and deliver clean, decision-ready data to the team. This is not a "spray and pray" lead farm. We value accuracy, margin discipline, and judgment over raw volume. You will be among other Virtual Assistants working within a professional workspace, with real SOPs, real tools, real coaching, and a real growth path.



Detail check (most applicants miss this): when you
 us, make the very first line of your message the single word VELOCITY — on its own line.



What You'll Do

— Source profitable OA/RA leads daily using SAS and Keepa.

— Vet every lead for ROI, sell-through velocity, Buy Box behavior, IP/gating risk, and competition.

— Deliver all found, organized leads in our 
/ Database Website with sourcing links and your analysis on each profitable lead found.

— Flag potential risks (price-tanking, Amazon on listing, OOS patterns, hazmat, gating) before we buy.

ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW



HOW TO APPLY, READ EVERY WORD:

The single most important trait of a great researcher is attention to detail. So our application is the first test. Applications that skip or miss any instruction below will not be reviewed— no exceptions. This is deliberate. If you can't follow our application instructions, you can't follow our sourcing SOPs.



There are three stages:



STAGE 1 is Application
 (Screening)

Send an
 with your resume attached and complete all of the following exactly:

1. Subject line, use this exact format: OA RESEARCHER – [YOUR FULL NAME] – [YOUR FAVORITE FOOD]

2. First line of your
 body must be the code word we hid earlier in this listing, on its own line at the very top. We won't tell you where it is— careful readers will have already found it.

3. A brief introduction. Sell yourself. Tell us about your real, profitable OA/RA experience and what you've personally sourced.

4. Reference one specific line from this listing that resonated with you, and explain why in one or two sentences.



5. Answer the sourcing math problem below. Show your work on a piece of paper and attach it to your application. Do not just give the final number:

A product sells for $29.99 on Amazon. Your unit cost is $14.50. Amazon's referral fee is 15% of the sale price, and the FBA fulfillment fee is $5.45 per unit.

(a) What is your net profit per unit?

(b) What is your ROI %?

(c) Would you source this product? At what minimum ROI and/or minimum profit do you personally pull the trigger, and why?



6. Confirm your availability for the preferred 6AM to 2PM PH overlap, or propose your hours.

— To prove you read this far: end your
 with the exact phrase "Leads ready by morning." Applications missing this phrase are auto-declined.



STAGE 2 is Keepa & OA Knowledge Test (No Interview Yet)

If your application is clean, we'll send you a short written test (answered in your own words, no copy-paste from Google or AI). that looks like this:

— On a Keepa chart, what does a drop (downward spike) in the Sales Rank line indicate? How would you use the "Sales Rank Drops – Last 30 / 90 days" figures to estimate monthly sales velocity?

— How do you use Keepa to determine how often Amazon itself is on a listing, and why does that change your buying decision?

We grade on accuracy and reasoning, not length. Fakers get filtered here.

Only candidates who pass Stages 1 and 2 are invited to a Zoom interview with the team. Reliable video/voice required.



Timeline: We review applications within 1–3 business days. We move fast on strong candidates and we don't waste good people's time. If you've read this whole listing, followed every instruction, and you genuinely know your numbers: we want to hear from you.

title: SEO + AI Search Specialist
description:
The Opportunity



Search is splitting in two. Half your future visitors will find you through Google. The other half will ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google's AI Overviews *"what's the best rehab that allows..."* — and get an answer with three sources cited.



We need one person who can win both.



We operate a portfolio of addiction treatment and behavioral health web properties, including a directory platform built on a modern stack (Next.js / Vercel / Supabase). Organic discovery is our primary growth channel, and we want to be early and aggressive on AI search visibility while competitors are still only thinking about Google.



What You'll Own



Traditional SEO (~60%)

- Keyword strategy, on-page optimization, and content direction for YMYL health topics

- Technical SEO on Next.js: rendering strategy, canonicals, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, crawlability

- Structured data implementation and expansion (
: MedicalClinic, FAQPage, MedicalOrganization)

- Programmatic SEO for state/city directory pages — scaled templates that don't read as thin content

- Migration support: an active WordPress ? Next.js rebuild with URL preservation and redirect mapping

- Competitive gap analysis against established treatment directories



AI Search / GEO (~40%)

- Get our properties **cited as sources** in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews for treatment-related queries

- Structure content for answer extraction: direct-answer formatting, question-based headings, definitive claims with data, citable statistics

- Entity and brand optimization: consistent entity signals, Wikipedia/Wikidata-adjacent presence, third-party mentions AI models learn from

- Implement and maintain llms.txt and monitor AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) — d
 what to allow and how to structure it

- Track AI visibility: monitor which queries surface us in AI answers, benchmark against competitors, and build a repeatable measurement process (this field has no Search Console — you'll help invent our instrumentation)

- Stay current: this discipline changes monthly, and we expect you to bring us the changes before we read about them



You're a Fit If You



- Have 3+ years of SEO results in competitive or YMYL niches (health, legal, finance) — with at least one win you can walk us through in detail

- Have *actually done* AI search optimization — you can show a page or brand you got cited in AI answers, or a documented experiment, not just articles you've read about GEO

- Are technical enough to work directly with a Next.js codebase conversation: you don't write the code, but you can spec exactly what the code should do

- Understand E-E-A-T and what it takes for health content to survive core updates

- Are comfortable in a scrappy, founder-led environment: no committees, fast decisions, your recommendations ship



**Nice to have:** behavioral health or healthcare marketing background, familiarity with treatment-marketing compliance (LegitScript, patient-brokering laws), experience with AI content workflows, basic SQL/Supabase. description

title: Video Editor
description:
VIDEO EDITOR

Remote (Philippines-Based)  |  Contract  |  Fixed Monthly Rate

We are a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in patient acquisition for cash-pay chiropractic clinics. Video is a core part of how we generate results for our clients — and we're looking for a skilled video editor based in the Philippines to join our team on a long-term contract basis.



This is not a one-off project. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, learn our style, and become a reliable part of our production workflow.



About the Role

You will edit both short-form and long-form video content for our chiropractic clinic clients. Short-form content includes social media ads, Reels, and promotional clips designed to generate patient leads. Long-form content includes educational videos, clinic walkthroughs, patient testimonials, and brand storytelling pieces.



You will receive raw footage, brand assets, and a creative brief for each project. Your job is to take that raw material and turn it into polished, professional content that performs — on time, every time.



You'll work closely with our content and creative team. Clear communication, reliability, and the ability to take direction and apply feedback quickly are just as important as your technical skill.



Required Skills & Experience

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:



• 5+ years of professional video editing experience — portfolio or work samples required

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

• Experience editing short-form content for social media platforms (Meta, Instagram Reels)

• Experience editing long-form content such as testimonials, educational videos, or brand videos

• Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and what makes video content hold attention

• Ability to add captions, lower thirds, motion graphics, and basic visual effects

• Reliable, fast, internet connection and the ability to receive, transfer, and deliver large video files

• Excellent written English communication — you will receive briefs and feedback in English

• Ability to meet deadlines consistently — we operate on a production schedule and turnaround time matters

• Must be able to attend and communicate with team throughout the day via Teams Meetings

• Must be familiar with current AI generated content and editors. Heggsfi



Applications without a portfolio or work samples will not be reviewed.



Preferred Skills

• Experience with Adobe After Effects for motion graphics or animated elements

• Familiarity with editing video content for healthcare, medical, or service-based businesses

• Experience with color grading and audio cleanup/mixing

• Familiarity with U.S. marketing styles and advertising content



Responsibilities

• Edit short-form social media ads, Reels, and promotional clips from raw footage and creative briefs

• Edit long-form educational, testimonial, and brand videos for clinic clients

• Add captions, graphics, music, and branding elements per project guidelines

• Apply feedback from the creative team efficiently and without needing multiple revision rounds

• Deliver final files in the correct formats and specifications for each platform

• Maintain an organized file system and communicate clearly on project status and timelines

• Flag any issues with raw footage, missing assets, or unclear briefs before beginning an edit



Compensation

• Fixed monthly rate — amount based on experiences

• Compensation discussed after portfolio review and initial interview

• Long-term contract with potential for rate increases as the relationship grows



Who Thrives in This Role

• You take ownership of your work — you don't wait to be chased for updates

• You apply feedback cleanly the first time without taking it personally

• You are consistent — same quality, same reliability, every week

• You are proactive when something is unclear rather than guessing and delivering the wrong thing

• You care about whether the content actually works, not just whether it looks good



If you're looking for occasional project work with no long-term commitment, this role is not the right fit. We are building a team, not a vendor list.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:



• A link to your portfolio or at least 3 samples of previous work — both short-form and long-form if available

• A brief written introduction (3–5 sentences) describing your editing background and the types of content you've worked on most

Applications submitted without work samples will not be reviewed.

title: High-Level DM Setter & Sales Closer
description:
Remote / Full-Time or Part-Time

Must be available during U.S. business hours and peak lead response windows

Base pay= $3/Hr + performance bonuses= $5 for every 5 qualified & booked calls + commission= $15 for each closed deal



**About Guidance2Action**

Guidance2Action helps entrepreneurs and individuals improve their credit profile, position themselves for funding, and gain access to financial education, business funding strategies, and mentorship. Our mission is to help clients move from credit confusion and funding denials into clarity, structure, and action.



**Role Overview**

We are looking for a high-performing DM Setter and Sales Closer who can manage inbound and outbound conversations across social media, CRM, SMS,
, and other communication channels. This person must be skilled at starting conversations, identifying pain points, qualifying prospects, booking consultations, following up aggressively but professionally, and helping convert leads into paid clients.



This is a sales-driven role. The ideal candidate understands urgency, pipeline management, emotional intelligence, objection handling, CRM discipline, and daily performance tracking. They must be able to represent Guidance2Action professionally while helping prospects understand whether credit repair, funding readiness, or mentorship is the right next step.



**Primary Responsibilities**



Manage inbound DMs, comments, SMS,
 replies, and CRM conversations from prospects interested in credit repair or funding.



Start and nurture conversations with leads using approved scripts, voice, tone, and qualification frameworks.



Identify each lead’s current situation, including credit score range, derogatory items, funding goals, business status, urgency, budget, readiness to take action, etc.



Book qualified prospects onto consultation calls in the appropriate pipeline, Calander and assigned to the appropriate tea
mber.



Confirm appointments, reduce no-shows, and follow up before and after scheduled consultations.



Close approved low-ticket or mid-ticket offers when assigned, including credit analysis calls, digital products, or credit repair packages.



Use objection-handling frameworks to address concerns around price, timing, trust, credit readiness, funding denials, and decision-making hesitation.



Maintain accurate lead records inside the CRM, including lead source, conversation status, qualification notes, appointment status, follow-up stage, and outcome.



Track daily numbers, sales activity, booked calls, show rate, close rate, response time, and revenue influenced.



Follow up with old leads, no-shows, ghosted leads, and warm prospects until they convert, disqualify, or request removal.



Communicate daily with leadership regarding hot leads, objections, bottlenecks, script issues, CRM issues, and sales opportunities.



Protect the brand by using compliant, ethical, and professional language. No false guarantees, misleading funding claims, fake credit promises, or pressure-based tactics.



**Required Skills**



Strong speaking and written English communication.



Proven DM setting, appointment setting, inside sales, or remote closing experience.



Ability to sell through conversation, not spam.



Strong follow-up discipline and CRM organization.



Comfortable discussing credit repair, funding, business growth, personal finance, or mentorship offers.



Ability to follow scripts while still sounding natural and human.



Strong emotional intelligence and ability to identify serious buyers versus unqualified leads.



Experience handling objections around price, trust, timing, spouse approval, previous bad experiences, and “I need to think about it.”



Comfortable working U.S. time zones.



Able to hit daily activity targets and weekly performance KPIs.



**Preferred Experience**



Experience with GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, DisputeFox, Skool, Kajabi, Instagram DMs,
 Messenger, SMS campaigns, or
 follow-up.



Experience selling credit repair, business funding, or digital products.



Experience working with U.S.-based entrepreneurs, coaches, agencies, financial brands, or service businesses.



**Success in This Role Looks Like**



Fast lead response time.



Clean CRM updates.



Consistent daily conversations.



Qualified appointments booked.



Low no-show rate.



Strong follow-up execution.



High consultation show rate.



Strong close rate on assigned offers.

Professional communication that protects the Guidance2Action brand.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success and Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: GHL Tech Ops and Support
description:
TECH OPS SPECIALIST

Remote (Philippines-Based)  |  Contract  |  Fixed Monthly Rate

Harvest Health Marketing, a division of Harvest Company, is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with cash-pay chiropractic clinics. GoHighLevel is the operational backbone of everything we build for our clients — and conversion tracking is the intelligence layer that tells us whether any of it is actually working.



We are looking for a Tech Ops Specialist based in the Philippines who combines deep GoHighLevel expertise with a precise understanding of conversion tracking, Meta CAPI integration, Google offline conversion uploads, and UTM parameter management. This is not a general virtual assistant role. It is a technical operations role that sits at the intersection of platform infrastructure, automation, and performance data integrity.



About the Role

You will be responsible for building and maintaining the full technical infrastructure that powers our client campaigns — from GHL automation buildouts to conversion tracking setup to ongoing data quality monitoring. When a lead comes in through a Meta ad, we need to know it was sourced correctly, tagged accurately, and that the conversion event fired back to the ad platform with the right data. That is your responsibility.



Conversion attribution is one of the most critical parts of digital marketing for our clients. A misfire on CAPI, a missing UTM parameter, or a misconfigured offline conversion upload doesn't just create a reporting gap — it causes the algorithm to optimize toward the wrong signals, inflates perceived CPL, and erodes ROAS. You will own the accuracy of this data layer across every client account.



This role requires daily availability during U.S. business hours for tea
etings via Microsoft Teams. Excellent English communication, both written and verbal, is required. If you cannot attend live meetings or communicate clearly and precisely in English, this role is not the right fit.



Conversion Tracking & Data Integrity — Core Requirements

This section is the most important part of this job posting. These are not preferred skills. They are hard requirements. If you do not have direct, hands-on experience with all of the following, please do not apply.



Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

You must understand how Meta CAPI works at a technical level — not just how to toggle it on inside GHL, but how server-side events are structured, how event deduplication works between browser pixel and server events, and how to diagnose when CAPI events are failing or mismatched.



MUST-HAVE: Direct experience configuring Meta CAPI through GoHighLevel's native integration and verifying event match quality scores inside Meta Events Manager. You must be able to identify and resolve deduplication errors, missing parameters, and low-quality event matches without external support.



• Configure Meta Pixel and CAPI integration inside GHL and verify that server-side events are firing correctly

• Monitor event match quality in Meta Events Manager and troubleshoot low scores caused by missing customer information parameters 
, phone, FBP, FBC)

• Ensure that lead events, appointment events, and custom conversion events are mapped correctly from GHL workflows to Meta

• Validate that browser pixel events and CAPI events are deduplicating properly to avoid inflated conversion counts

• Understand the difference between standard events and custom events and when to use each for chiropractic patient acquisition campaigns



Google Offline Conversion Uploads

Our Google Ads campaigns generate leads that convert offline — a patient calls, books an appointment, shows up, and signs a care plan. You must be able to take that downstream conversion data and upload it back into Google Ads so the algorithm can optimize toward the leads that actually become patients, not just form fills.



MUST-HAVE: Hands-on experience setting up and managing Google Offline Conversion Imports — including GCLID capture inside GHL, CSV upload processes or API-based uploads, and conversion action configuration inside Google Ads. You must understand how GCLIDs expire and how to maintain upload cadence to preserve attribution windows.



• Configure GCLID capture inside GHL so that every inbound lead from Google Ads retains its click identifier through the CRM pipeline

• Set up and manage Google Offline Conversion Import actions inside Google Ads — naming conventions, attribution models, and conversion windows

• Build and manage the upload process for offline conversion data — either manual CSV uploads or automated workflows — on a consistent schedule

• Diagnose upload errors including expired GCLIDs, missing conversion times, formatting issues, and mismatched conversion action names

• Work with the media buying team to identify which downstream pipeline stages represent the most valuable optimization signals for Google's bidding algorithm



UTM Parameter Management & Attribution

Every lead that enters our system must be correctly tagged with UTM parameters so we know exactly which campaign, ad set, and ad generated it. This data must flow from the ad platform through the landing page, into GHL, and be visible at the contact level. Gaps in this chain make optimization impossible.



MUST-HAVE: The ability to build, audit, and enforce a complete UTM tracking architecture across Meta and Google campaigns, GHL landing pages, and contact records — and to identify exactly where attribution is breaking when UTM data is missing or incorrect at the CRM level.



• Build and maintain consistent UTM naming conventions across all Meta and Google campaigns in alignment with the media buying team

• Configure GHL landing pages and forms to correctly capture and store UTM parameters at the contact level

• Audit existing contact records to identify gaps in UTM capture and diagnose root causes — whether at the page level, form level, or workflow level

• Set up custom fields and pipeline views inside GHL that surface UTM source data clearly for reporting purposes

• Validate that UTM data passed from GHL into conversion uploads or reporting integrations is accurate and complete

• Identify when UTM parameters are being stripped by redirects, landing page configurations, or browser privacy settings and implement solutions



GoHighLevel Platform Requirements

In addition to the tracking and attribution requirements above, you must have broad and deep GoHighLevel expertise across the following areas:



• 2+ years of hands-on GHL experience — actual buildout and management, not platform familiarity

• Complex multi-step automation builds including conditional logic, triggers, wait steps, branching workflows, and webhook actions

• Landing page and funnel buildout inside GHL optimized for patient lead generation

• SMS campaign setup including drip sequences, appointment reminders, and lead follow-up automations

• A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers — you understand the process, the compliance requirements, and how to resolve rejections

• GHL sub-account setup and configuration including pipelines, stages, custom fields, tags, and user permissions

• Integration experience with Meta Lead Ads, Google Ads, and third-party tools via Zapier or Make (Integromat)

• Troubleshooting across all GHL functions — automation failures, form submission issues, calendar conflicts, message delivery failures

• Clear documentation of all builds so the team understands architecture, logic, and maintenance requirements



Communication & Availability Requirements

MUST-HAVE: Excellent written and spoken English is required. You will attend daily tea
etings, receive and interpret technical briefs, communicate blockers clearly, and document your work in English. This is a collaborative role, not a siloed task queue.



MUST-HAVE: A fast, stable internet connection capable of supporting daily video calls via Microsoft Teams without interruption. Connectivity issues are not acceptable in a role that requires daily live collaboration with a U.S.-based team.



• Available for daily tea
etings during U.S. business hours — schedule to be confirmed at time of hire

• Responsive during working hours — expected to reply to messages and flag issues within a reasonable timeframe, not at end of day

• Proactive communicator — you surface problems before they escalate and ask clarifying questions before building in the wrong direction



Preferred Background

• Prior experience working inside a U.S.-based digital marketing agency serving local service businesses

• Familiarity with healthcare or medical advertising constraints on Meta and Google

• Experience with Google Tag Manager for pixel and event management

• Understanding of server-side tagging concepts beyond GHL's native CAPI integration

• Experience with reporting tools that pull GHL and ad platform data into unified dashboards



Responsibilities

• Own the full technical buildout of GHL environments for new client onboarding

• Configure and maintain Meta CAPI integration across all client accounts and monitor event quality ongoing

• Set up and manage Google Offline Conversion Upload processes for all active Google Ads clients

• Build and enforce UTM tracking architecture across Meta and Google campaigns and validate capture at the GHL contact level

• Build complex automations for lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show re-engagement, and nurture sequences

• Build and optimize landing pages and opt-in forms for patient lead generation

• Set up SMS and
 campaigns and complete A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers

• Audit conversion data regularly to identify tracking gaps, attribution errors, and misconfigured events
