title: Shortform Video Editor – Personal Brand / Storytelling Content
description:
I'm Pharrell – a young father, entrepreneur, and athlete documenting my real life on Instagram. I'm launching a new series called "This Is What It Takes" – a raw, honest, and cinematic look at what it actually costs to build a great life: the routines, the sacrifices, the mindset, the wins, and the pain.



Think voiceover-driven storytelling, real A-roll footage, and carefully chosen B-roll from my personal library. No stock footage!



Reference videos from my content:

• ----------

• ----------

• ----------



---



**What You'll Be Doing**



Editing 1–2 Instagram Reels per week in this series. Each episode is a voiceover-driven short film. Your job is not just to cut footage together, it's to tell a story visually.



Specifically, you will:

- Prepare A-Roll Footage by color grading it, and deleting pauses and repetitions

- Select and place B-roll from my personal library that matches what's being said

- Know when to let a ---------- nt breathe and when to cut it short

- Create song switches at the right emotional beats

- Use black screens intentionally - when something lands, let it land

- Keep audio balanced: voiceover clear, music at the right level, SFX if appropriate

- Apply clean, on-brand subtitles with zero grammar or spelling errors

- Apply consistent, clean color grading that fits my brand



---



**What I Provide**



- A-roll footage for each episode

- A personal B-roll library (updated bi-weekly with fresh content)

- A weekly selection of songs to choose from

- A script and overall direction for each episode



---



**What I'm Looking For**



This role is not about fancy editing. It's about storytelling instinct.



I need an editor who:

- Has worked on voiceover-driven short-form content before (personal brand, documentary-style, or similar)

- Understands *why* you'd cut something — not just *how*

- Can identify which parts of a clip drag a story down and remove them without being told

- Knows the difference between a song transition and a song switch — and when each is right

- Has a strong eye for subtitle styling (clean, readable, on-brand — not TikTok-font chaos)

- Does not use stock footage under any circumstances

- Catches their own mistakes before delivery (audio levels, subtitle typos, color consistency)



**Please do not apply if you:** over-edit, rely on stock footage, deliver without proofing your own work, or don't have examples of storytelling-style content you've edited.



---



**Rate & Volume**



- $25–$30 per reel (based on experience and quality)

- Minimum 1 reel per week / target is 2 per week

- This is a long-term ongoing role for the right person



---



**How to Apply**



Send me:

1. 2–3 examples of voiceover-driven or storytelling-style content you've edited (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar)

2. A short note (3–5 sentences) on why you think you're the right fit for this specific series



Applications without examples will not be considered.

Join the team behind Clipster.gg! We help social media creators around the world earn money by connecting them with top brands in music, gaming, and entertainment. From TikTok to YouTube Shorts, our tools help creators monetize without compromising creativity — and that's where you come in.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll handle frontline support yourself when needed, but you'll increasingly focus on improving SOPs, raising response quality, spotting recurring issues, and (as the team grows) guiding other support agents. This role is essential to creator satisfaction, retention, and trust.

title: OJT - Vibe Coder - Remote
description:
Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)





THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.



Must-have:

-Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

-AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

- Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

-Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

-Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.



Nice to have:

-You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

-You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

-You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

-You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

-You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

-You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

-You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

-You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

-You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

-You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

-You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

asures themselves against. Someone who has done this work at a senior level, knows what great looks like from the inside, and is ready to build something.

We run an AI-native lifestyle management platform for the world's most demanding clients — founders, athletes, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals who expect their personal and professional lives to run without friction.



Our members do not manage logistics. We do. Across travel, dining, private experiences, luxury goods, and wellness — everything is handled, anticipated, and elevated by a team that operates at the highest level of personal service.

On the leadership side, you are the benchmark. As the team scales, you will bring new Lifestyle Managers up to speed, review their work, and hold the quality line on every member interaction that goes out.

nt.

title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

•	Prepare clear management updates with risks, blockers, recommended decisions, next actions, and execution priorities.

•	Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, operation trackers, and Amazon operation documents organized and updated.

•	Flag weak assumptions, supplier risks, launch risks, listing risks, inventory risks, Amazon account concerns, or execution issues early.

•	For Lead-level candidates: review junior/support work, improve SOPs, templates, checklists, trackers, and help raise execution quality over time.





Qualifications:



•	Specialist level: 2-4+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	Lead level: 5-8+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	General Amazon FBA experience alone is not enough unless it includes hands-on Private Label work.

•	Experience with Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, post-launch monitoring, and Amazon operations support.

•	Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and structured research templates.

•	Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, profitability, launch difficulty, and product differentiation.

•	Strong supplier communication and follow-up skills, especially with China-based suppliers.

•	Strong written English communication and clear reporting ability.

•	Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product opportunities at different stages.

•	Comfortable following SOPs while also using judgment when a business decision requires practical thinking.

•	Comfortable using AI tools to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, workflow speed, and communication while verifying information carefully.

•	Able to work independently and provide clear updates, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

•	Comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon Private Label operations.





KPIs / Success Measures:



•	Quality and accuracy of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, listing preparation, launch support, and operation files.

•	Quality of product opportunity judgment and ability to separate weak products from realistic launch candidates.

•	Accuracy of market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, review analysis, profitability assumptions, and launch planning inputs.

•	Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, product improvement requests, sample coordination, and supplier follow-up.

•	Ability to identify risks early before they affect product selection, supplier selection, launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

•	Clear communication of blockers, risks, next steps, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.

•	Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, cost assumptions, and research reports.

•	Reliable ownership across product research, sourcing, product development, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

•	For Lead-level candidates: ability to improve execution quality, guide junior/support work, and improve SOPs, templates, or trackers when needed.

•	Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards while also applying sound judgment.





What We Offer:



•	Part-time or full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

•	Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

•	Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

•	Structured SOPs, templates, and process support.

•	Direct communication with company management.

•	Opportunity to grow into higher ownership based on proven capability and results.

•	Performance-based growth opportunities based on ownership, reliability, and execution quality.





Application Instructions:



To apply, please include the phrase "Amazon PL Role" in the first line of your application and answer the following questions briefly:

1.	Are you applying for Specialist level, Lead level, or open to either level based on assessment?

2.	Are you applying for full-time or part-time work? If part-time, how many hours per week can you consistently commit?

3.	How many years of direct Amazon Private Label experience do you have?

4.	Which Amazon tools have you used directly? Please mention Helium 10, Keepa, Seller Central, Alibaba, or others if applicable.

5.	Describe one private label product you helped identify, source, launch, improve, or scale. Please mention your exact role in the process.

6.	What makes a product a poor private label launch candidate, even if the sales look strong?

7.	Are you comfortable completing a practical Amazon PL assessment before final hiring?

mbers when needed.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

KPIs / Success Measures:

What We Offer:

title: Senior Content Editor & Media Manager
description:

I'm looking for someone who can take my raw recordings and transform them into polished, professional content while helping to manage and organise our media library.



This is a long-term role for someone who loves creating exceptional educational content and has a strong eye for detail, clarity and quality.



Core Responsibilities

- Video Editing

- Improve flow, clarity and viewer experience.

- Ensure all content is polished, professional and engaging.

- Podcast Production

- Upload and schedule episodes.



Content Management

nts and "gold nuggets" from trainings and podcasts.

The Ideal Person Will Have

Essential Experience

Vimeo

Content repurposing

title: Brand & Content Creator (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health and improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain and discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain and distress others have to endure.



We’re seeking a full-time Brand and Content Creator to lead the creative direction of our brand across packaging, offline marketing, and digital platforms. This role is ideal for a strategic, hands-on creative who can own both design and content production, from ideation to execution, while supporting our expansion across Southeast Asia and global markets.



As a key member of the team, you'll be responsible for producing compelling visuals and content that reflect the heart of our brand and connect meaningfully with consumers, healthcare professionals, and distribution partners.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Brand Development & Creative Direction

*Lead development of visual identity for new and existing brands, including logos, packaging, brand guidelines, typography and brand story

*Propose and implement creative directions from Pantone color palettes to iconography, font systems and photography guidelines

*Establish and maintain consistent branding across all physical and digital touchpoints, while ensuring all brand assets are stored and updated in an organized, easily accessible database



2. Graphic & Marketing Design

*Design high-impact materials such as product packaging, brochures, point-of-sale displays, in-store visuals and Continuing Medical Education (CME) event collaterals

*Develop pitch decks, sales presentations and brand kits for internal and external stakeholders

*Create visuals for promotions, campaigns, and trade shows for greater awareness and conversion



3. Content Creation & Copywriting

*Collaborate with the team to develop content ideas and messaging for various platforms (digital ads, social media, web,
)

*Write and edit marketing copy as needed, including taglines, brand messaging, product descriptions, and promotional materials

*Contribute to storytelling, campaign ideation, consumer education initiatives, and customer loyalty initiatives



4. Digital & Multimedia Content

*Produce digital assets for ecommerce platforms, social media ads, newsletters, and display ads (Google Ads Meta, TikTok)

*Edit videos and animations for campaigns, tutorials, events, and educational content using tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

*Repurpose content across multiple formats and languages when applicable



5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

*Work closely with marketing, sales, pharmacists and leadership to turn strategic goals into compelling creative output

*Participate in product launch discussions and brand development brainstorming sessions

*Coordinate with external freelancers or vendors as needed



6. Regional Support & Market Expansion

*Adapt assets for regional markets including Singapore, Malaysia, Mainland China & Hong Kong and future expansion areas

*Ensure consistency across regions while accounting for local cultural, language, market and regulatory differences



Requirements:

*Minimum 3–5 years of experience in graphic design, video editing, brand development, content creation, or multimedia production

*Strong portfolio showcasing design, branding, video editing, and content/copywriting capabilities across print & digital

*Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

*Excellent understanding of branding, packaging, digital marketing, and customer communication

*Creative thinker with strong attention to detail and an eye for aesthetic balance

*Highly organized, self-driven, and able to manage multiple timelines in a fast-paced environment

*Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in remote work settings

*Experience in the health, wellness, pharmaceutical, or consumer goods sector is a plus

*Degree in Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred but not mandatory



Kindly submit your updated CV and sample portfolio to 
 for our review.

title: Operations Manager (Remote) – Systems, KPIs & Business Operations
description:
# Operations & Systems Manager (Remote – Full-Time)



### **This is NOT an administrative assistant position.**



We are looking for a highly analytical **Operations & Systems Manager** who enjoys building dashboards, developing KPIs, improving business processes, facilitating leadership meetings, and helping a CEO execute company strategy.



If you love creating systems, organizing chaos, holding teams accountable, and using data to drive decisions, this role is for you.



**This position requires someone who can think strategically, build operational infrastructure, and help scale a growing organization—not simply complete administrative tasks.**



---



## About Us



Elevation Individual and Family Therapy is a rapidly growing multi-location mental health organization serving clients throughout Illinois and Indiana. We are passionate about building an organization that delivers exceptional care while operating with excellence behind the scenes.



We are looking for an experienced Operations & Systems Manager who loves structure, systems, data, and accountability. This is not an administrative assistant position. We need someone who enjoys building processes, organizing teams, tracking performance, and making businesses run better.



If you naturally think, "There has to be a better way to do this," you'll probably love this role.



---



# About the Role



Our CEO is highly visionary and growth-focused. Your role is to translate vision into execution.



You will build systems, organize projects, hold leaders accountable, monitor KPIs, create dashboards, facilitate meetings, and ensure initiatives move from ideas to completion.



You will become the operational hub of the company.



---



# What You'll Be Responsible For



### Operational Leadership



* Build and improve operational systems

* Document and improve workflows

* Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Identify inefficiencies and recommend solutions

* Improve communication across departments

* Ensure projects are completed on time



### KPI Development & Reporting



You will build executive dashboards that track the health of the company.



Examples include:



* Revenue

* Collections

* Accounts Receivable

* Therapist productivity

* Documentation compliance

* Scheduling utilization

* Client satisfaction

* Referral sources

* Administrative performance

* Hiring metrics

* Credentialing progress

* Marketing performance

* Financial trends



You'll create reports that allow leadership to quickly understand what is happening across the business.



---



### Dashboard Creation



You'll build dashboards using tools like:



* Airtable

* 

* ClickUp

* Google Sheets

* Excel

* Looker Studio

* Power BI (preferred)



You should enjoy turning messy data into simple visual reports.



---



### Meeting Leadership



You will:



* Run weekly leadership meetings

* Create agendas

* Capture action items

* Assign ownership

* Follow up on commitments

* Keep projects moving

* Ensure accountability



You are comfortable respectfully asking leaders for updates and helping them stay on track.



---



### Project Management



You'll oversee multiple projects simultaneously such as:



* New service launches

* Software implementation

* Process improvements

* Hiring initiatives

* Operational changes

* Technology rollouts

* Workflow redesign

* Cross-department initiatives



Nothing should "fall through the cracks."



---



### Data & Analytics



You should enjoy working with numbers.



Responsibilities include:



* Tracking trends

* Building reports

* Identifying operational bottlenecks

* Finding opportunities for improvement

* Making recommendations backed by data



---



### Process Improvement



You'll constantly ask questions like:



* Can this be automated?

* Can this process be simplified?

* Can we reduce manual work?

* Can this dashboard update automatically?

* Can this report be easier to understand?



Continuous improvement is expected.



---



### Executive Support



You'll work closely with the CEO by:



* Organizing priorities

* Following up on projects

* Preparing reports

* Monitoring company goals

* Keeping initiatives moving

* Reducing decision fatigue

* Creating structure around growth



Your success will allow the CEO to spend less time managing operations and more time growing the business.



---



# Required Skills



* Excellent English communication

* Exceptional organization

* Strong project management

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets

* Dashboard creation

* KPI reporting

* Process documentation

* Meeting facilitation

* Strong written communication

* Excellent follow-through

* Critical thinking

* Time management

* High attention to detail



---



# Preferred Experience



Experience with one or more of the following:



* Airtable

* 

* ClickUp

* Asana

* Notion

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Workspace

* Power BI

* Looker Studio

* Zapier

* 

* AI tools such as ChatGPT



Experience supporting founders or CEOs is a significant plus.



---



# The Ideal Person



You are someone who:



* Loves structure

* Loves organization

* Enjoys creating systems

* Notices details others miss

* Naturally follows up with people

* Thinks several steps ahead

* Is comfortable leading meetings

* Can respectfully hold people accountable

* Enjoys solving operational problems

* Is proactive instead of reactive

* Doesn't wait to be told what to do

* Takes ownership



---



# To Apply (Required)



**Applications that do not include ALL of the items below will not be considered.**



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A brief introduction about yourself.

3. **Screenshots or examples of dashboards you personally built.**

4. **A list of KPIs you have created or managed.**

5. A list of the software you have used (Airtable, ClickUp, 
, Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, etc.).

6. The largest team or organization you have supported.

7. **A 3–5 minute Loom video** introducing yourself and answering the following:



   * Tell us about a business process you improved.

   * What problem did it solve?

   * What systems or tools did you implement?

   * What measurable results did you achieve?

8. Include the phrase **"Systems Drive Success"** as the first line of your application so we know you read the entire job posting.



We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity, turning ideas into action, and helping a growing organization scale with excellence.
